এই চাকরির জন্য বিজ্ঞাপনদাতা ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠান আপনার কাছ থেকে কোন অর্থ চাইলে কিংবা নিয়োগ প্রক্রিয়া চলাকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানিমূলক (শারীরিক/মানসিক) আচরণ করলে অতিসত্ত্বর আমাদেরকে জানান অথবা জবটি রিপোর্ট করুন। চাকরি পাওয়ার জন্য কোন ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠানকে অর্থ প্রদান করবেন না। চাকরিকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানির (শারীরিক/মানসিক) সম্ভাবনা থাকলে সেখানে জয়েন করবেন না। কোন প্রকার অর্থ লেনদেন বা নিয়োগদাতা কর্তৃক হয়রানির দায়িত্ব বিডিজবস বহন করবে না।

Educational qualifications will be relaxed for experienced & deserving candidates. Experience 1 to 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Furniture Manufacturer, Importer, Interior Design, Sanitary ware, Tiles/Ceramic, Trading or Export/Import Additional Requirements Minimum 1 to 2 years of experience in the same work field will be considered as added value. Smart Communication in English No Adherence issues will be allowed. Maintain office time. Manage inbound and outbound calls, as well as customer inquiries received through social media platforms, with a strong focus on sales generation and after-sales service. Take full responsibility for ERP-related activities, inventory and stock management, quotation preparation, invoice creation, and other related system operations. Regularly monitor and coordinate day-to-day showroom administrative, housekeeping, and cleaning matters to ensure a well-maintained working environment. Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports, product documentation, training materials, and other required reports. Follow up regularly on pending deliveries and coordinate with the relevant teams to ensure timely delivery to customers. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of all products, including product features, specifications, benefits, pricing, and availability. Perform any other duties, responsibilities, or special assignments entrusted by the Top Management from time to time. Requirements Education Bachelors degree with a major in Marketing Additional Requirements Strong interest in Sales & Marketing Career-oriented and willing to build a long-term career Freshers are encouraged to apply Responsibilities & Context ORTRIO Limited, a subsidiary of AKSID Corporation Limited, is the exclusive distribution partner for a leading manufacturer of specialty water treatment chemicals in Bangladesh. We are seeking a mid-level Marketing & Sales Representative to drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth across industrial sectors. This role is ideal for a technically proficient sales professional eager to excel in a high-growth, B2B technical sales environment. Key Responsibilities New Business Development: Identify and acquire new customers across targeted industries including textiles, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, power, and manufacturing. Build a strong sales pipeline and expand the market for water treatment chemicals. Client Relationship Management: Develop strong relationships with plant managers, engineers, procurement teams, and other key decision-makers. Conduct regular site visits to understand customer requirements. Technical Sales & Consulting: Provide technical guidance on water treatment solutions, including boiler, cooling tower, RO, and wastewater applications. Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and trials. Sales Target Achievement: Meet and exceed assigned sales targets through effective territory management, account planning, negotiation, and customer conversion while maintaining company profitability guidelines. Market Intelligence: Track market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs, providing relevant insights to management. Reporting & Coordination: Maintain sales records, prepare forecasts and reports, and coordinate with technical, marketing, logistics, and customer service teams to ensure effective customer support. Working Conditions Work Environment: Based at AKSIDs Head Office in Dhaka, with a significant amount of time spent in the field. Expect a field-oriented role, visiting industrial facilities, production plants, and client offices regularly. Travel Requirements: Frequent travel within Bangladesh (up to 60-70% of the time) to meet clients on-site. This includes travel to industrial hubs outside Dhaka. A valid driving license and willingness to travel by car and occasionally by air/rail to distant client sites are required. Reporting Line: You will report to the Managing Director at Ortrio. Regular meetings and reporting will be required to discuss pipeline status, market issues, and strategy. Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams including technical service engineers from Metito, marketing team, and customer service/logistics to ensure timely product delivery and support. Schedule: Full-time position (weekday business hours), with flexibility needed to accommodate client schedules. Occasionally, you may need to attend industry events or client meetings in evenings or weekends as per business needs. Responsibilities & Context
ORTRIO Limited, a subsidiary of AKSID Corporation Limited, is the exclusive distribution partner for a leading manufacturer of specialty water treatment chemicals in Bangladesh. We are seeking a mid-level Marketing & Sales Representative to drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth across industrial sectors. This role is ideal for a technically proficient sales professional eager to excel in a high-growth, B2B technical sales environment.
New Business Development: Identify and acquire new customers across targeted industries including textiles, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, power, and manufacturing. Build a strong sales pipeline and expand the market for water treatment chemicals.
Client Relationship Management: Develop strong relationships with plant managers, engineers, procurement teams, and other key decision-makers. Conduct regular site visits to understand customer requirements.
Technical Sales & Consulting: Provide technical guidance on water treatment solutions, including boiler, cooling tower, RO, and wastewater applications. Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and trials.
Sales Target Achievement: Meet and exceed assigned sales targets through effective territory management, account planning, negotiation, and customer conversion while maintaining company profitability guidelines.
Market Intelligence: Track market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs, providing relevant insights to management.
Reporting & Coordination: Maintain sales records, prepare forecasts and reports, and coordinate with technical, marketing, logistics, and customer service teams to ensure effective customer support.
Work Environment: Based at AKSID`s Head Office in Dhaka, with a significant amount of time spent in the field. Expect a field-oriented role, visiting industrial facilities, production plants, and client offices regularly.
Travel Requirements: Frequent travel within Bangladesh (up to 60-70% of the time) to meet clients on-site. This includes travel to industrial hubs outside Dhaka. A valid driving license and willingness to travel by car and occasionally by air/rail to distant client sites are required.
Reporting Line: You will report to the Managing Director at Ortrio. Regular meetings and reporting will be required to discuss pipeline status, market issues, and strategy.
Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams including technical service engineers from Metito, marketing team, and customer service/logistics to ensure timely product delivery and support.
Schedule: Full-time position (weekday business hours), with flexibility needed to accommodate client schedules. Occasionally, you may need to attend industry events or client meetings in evenings or weekends as per business needs.

এই চাকরির জন্য বিজ্ঞাপনদাতা ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠান আপনার কাছ থেকে কোন অর্থ চাইলে কিংবা নিয়োগ প্রক্রিয়া চলাকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানিমূলক (শারীরিক/মানসিক) আচরণ করলে অতিসত্ত্বর আমাদেরকে জানান অথবা জবটি রিপোর্ট করুন। চাকরি পাওয়ার জন্য কোন ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠানকে অর্থ প্রদান করবেন না। চাকরিকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানির (শারীরিক/মানসিক) সম্ভাবনা থাকলে সেখানে জয়েন করবেন না। কোন প্রকার অর্থ লেনদেন বা নিয়োগদাতা কর্তৃক হয়রানির দায়িত্ব বিডিজবস বহন করবে না।

A reputed private commercial bank in Bangladesh is looking for young, energetic, confident, and target-oriented individuals for the position of Direct Sales Trainee under its Retail Banking Division.
This is an excellent opportunity for candidates who are interested in building a career in Banking, Sales, Customer Relationship Management, and Financial Services.
The selected candidates will work in a direct sales/field-based environment and will be responsible for acquiring new customers and promoting the Bank`s retail banking products and services.
Acquire new customers through direct sales, field visits, referrals, networking, and other approved channels.
Promote the Bank`s retail banking products and services to prospective customers.
Generate quality leads and convert prospective customers into business.
Visit potential customers and provide clear information regarding product features, benefits, eligibility, pricing, and documentation requirements.
Achieve assigned monthly sales and customer acquisition targets.
Develop and maintain professional relationships with new and existing customers.
Conduct regular follow-up with prospective customers to ensure successful conversion.
Collect and submit customer applications and required documents accurately.
Coordinate with relevant Bank departments for smooth processing of customer applications.
Provide appropriate customer support throughout the application and onboarding process.
Maintain daily and monthly sales reports and submit them to the concerned supervisor.
Ensure all sales activities are conducted in accordance with the Bank`s policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Perform any other responsibilities assigned by the supervisor/management.

Performance-based incentive.

Candidates must be able to describe specific sourcing work they personally carried out. Sufficient technical literacy to read and write product specifications and assess build quality, materials, and durability. Currently based in Dhaka, with the mobility and willingness to spend a substantial share of working time in markets and workshops across the city. Fluency in both English and Bangla. Ability to work independently with limited supervision, plan ones own fieldwork, and deliver on schedule. Competence in maintaining structured records in spreadsheets and writing clear, organised reports. Not required but any experience with connected or remotely managed devices (e.g., IoT controllers, pay-as-you-go solar, vehicle telematics) would be useful. Assets Experience sourcing cooling, refrigeration, solar, or battery-powered equipment. Prior work in or around informal markets, street vending, or urban informal enterprise. Background IFPRI, in partnership with the Shakti Foundation, one of Bangladeshs largest microfinance institutions, is developing and evaluating an asset-based loan product that will help street food vendors in Dhaka acquire mobile cooling solutions. As part of our research, the product will be offered to a sample of vendors during an initial launch and rigorously evaluated through a randomized controlled trial. A central design feature of the product is that vendors will be offered a menu of mobile cooling solutions at a range of price points, so that each vendor can select what fits the scale of their business and the goods they sell. This can include products that serve to cool both the food being sold, the vendor themselves, or both, as well as ventilation solutions for vendors who cook on site or at home. This is likely to include insulated/ventilated cart modifications, evaporative cooling units, battery-powered coolers, or other lithium battery based solution packages.

Participate in price, quantity, delivery schedule, payment terms and other commercial negotiations with customers, subject to management approval. Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Production, Quality Control, Accounts, Logistics and Management teams to ensure smooth execution of customer requirements. Maintain records of customer visits, inquiries, leads, quotations, negotiations, orders and follow-ups. Work toward achieving assigned sales, customer acquisition and market development targets. Identify new product opportunities based on market demand and provide recommendations to Management. Support the development of new marketing strategies for expanding the company’s customer base and market presence. Maintain professional communication and protect the company’s brand while dealing with customers and business partners. Maintain confidentiality of customer databases, pricing information, commercial information and other company-sensitive information. We are one of Bangladesh`s most reputed and diversified business conglomerates, with a rich history of success across various industries including Garment, Textiles, Cement, Feed, Agri, and more. This program serves as a career acceleration platform for candidates with strong potential and a drive for excellence.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1539584&fc.title: Asst. Executive / Executive – HR & Admin

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Human Resource Management PGD on HRM will be given preference.
raw_source_fields.age: At least 25 years Working knowledge of labor law and factory compliance. Good command of MS Office and email communication. Good interpersonal, communication (verbal and written), and analytical skills. Ability to plan, prioritize, and handle multiple tasks effectively. Professional attitude, integrity, and strong sense of responsibility. Well organized, detail-oriented, and a good team player. Responsibilities & Context Job Context We are looking for a dedicated and energetic HR & Admin professional to support the day-to-day operations of our power plant in Chattogram. In this role, you will provide HR generalist support and administrative support to the plant. Job Responsibilities Support the recruitment and selection process of the plant, including CV screening, interview scheduling, and coordination. Verify documents of joining employees and complete onboarding and joining formalities. Assist in conducting orientation for new joiners at the plant. Maintain and update employee files, HRIS/database, and personnel records. Maintain daily attendance, leave, overtime, and shift records, and provide inputs for payroll processing. Follow up on daily HR activities as per company policy. Assist in handling employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and counseling. Coordinate training programs as per the Training Needs Analysis (TNA), including logistics, attendance, and records. Support the performance appraisal process and assist with exit formalities for departing employees. Assist in ensuring compliance with the Bangladesh Labour Act 2006 (amended 2018), the Factories Act, and other related regulations. Prepare regular HR reports and MIS for management. Support general administration, office management, and logistics at the plant. Coordinate the transport pool, security, housekeeping, and procurement of office supplies. Assist in managing canteen, dormitory, and other staff welfare facilities. Support the HSE team in health, safety, fire, and environmental compliance activities. Assist in liaison with government offices, law enforcement agencies, and regulatory bodies. Assist in company license renewals, registrations, and legal documentation. Maintain vendor and service-provider records, contracts, and bill processing for admin services. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Administration Human Resource Management Recruitment & Selection Employee Relations Labor Law

About the role
This role supports our hiring, mainly for field sales positions, which we recruit for all year round. You will help find, screen, and follow up with candidates, and make sure new hires join and settle in smoothly.
What you will do
Source candidates through BDJobs, LinkedIn, social media, and other channels
Screen CVs and conduct initial screening calls
Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and collect feedback
Follow up with candidates through interviews, offers, and joining
Collect joining documents and support onboarding of new hires
Keep the recruitment tracker up to date and prepare hiring progress reports
What we are looking for
Undergraduate student or fresh graduate in HR, Business Administration, or a related field
Good communication skills in Bangla and English
Organized and responsible, with good follow-up
Able to take initiative and learn fast
HR internship experience is a plus
Other Relevant Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
A clear path to a full-time role after 3-6 months, based on performance, with an attractive full-time salary package
Monthly internship stipend
Mobile allowance

Hands-on recruitment experience with mentor guidance

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Commerce (BCom)
raw_source_fields.age: 20 to 30 years Only Male Good communication and coordination skills. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Hard working, willingness to go market for product sourcing and buying. Responsibilities & Context HBF was founded in 2013 in Gazipur and is a company for fiber products that are manufactured by hand or semi-automatically. Our products are customized and niche products for high quality goods. We are seeking a detail-oriented, hard-working, and responsible Assistant Officer, Accounts & Purchase to join our Accounts team. If you are passionate about accounting and looking to build a strong career in this field, we want to hear from you! Accounts & HR Responsibilities: Maintain & prepare all kind of voucher and posting to the books of accounts. Prepare and maintain different sorts of bill, voucher & requisition slips. To maintain the company accounting activities. Keep record of all office expenses, payroll entries, invoices and other accounting documents. Able to cash management. Provide day to day administrative support. Able to Prepare Daily Receive & Payment Statements. Give support to worker recruitment, documentation, absent list etc. Purchase Responsibilities: Research and identify potential vendors, suppliers, and market trends. Negotiate pricing, delivery terms, and contract conditions with suppliers. Monitor stock levels to prevent shortages or excess inventory. Inspect delivered goods and resolve issues with defective products or delayed shipments. Maintain updated databases of supplier information, invoices, and purchase logs. Perform any other task given by the Management.
raw_source_fields.gender: Only males are allowed to apply.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1538966&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in any discipline from a reputed university. Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Automobile, Furniture Manufacturer, Bicycle, Motor Workshop, Motor Vehicle body manufacturer, Manufacturing (FMCG), Food (Packaged)/Beverage, Electronic Equipment/Home Appliances Additional Requirements Age 24 to 36 years Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in workshop material procurement/purchasing is required. Responsibilities & Context Source vehicle related spare parts/materials as per workshop requirements from local suppliers and identify reliable vendors. Collect quotations, evaluate offers, and compare prices to ensure competitive procurement. Prepare Comparative Statement (CS) and any other report assigned by management. Negotiate prices, payment terms, and delivery schedules with suppliers. Arrange purchase order, Check bills and process for payment. Coordinate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of materials. Develop alternative supplier sources for cost optimization and strengthening the supply chain. Visit local market on emergency basis for arranging vehicle related items. Handle urgent procurement requirements and management assignments. Ensure compliance with company procurement policies and maintain proper procurement documentation. Skills & Expertise Cost Management Local Procurement Motor Workshop Purchase/ Procurement Reporting and Documentation Sourcing Product and Supplier Spare Parts Procurement Compensation & Other Benefits Provident fund,Insurance,Gratuity,Mobile bill,Medical allowance Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Other Benefits as per company policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Should have basic computer operating skill particularly in MS Word, Excel. Ready to residing factory surrounding areas. Responsibilities & Context About The Company: M&J Group entered into manufacturing activities in 1963 by establishing a flour milling company. The business horizon was expanded in 1989 when the garment manufacturing factory was opened. Now with its 8 sister concerns, M&J Group is a leading manufacturer in Bangladesh. The group is producing a wide range of top-quality denim bottoms including some non-denim products. M&J Group aspires to be the leading supplier in the global fashion business by offering the best expertise and knowledge in producing Ready Made Garments. Job Responsibilities Manage the day-to-day operation of the Fair Price Shop. Maintain adequate stock of groceries, snacks, beverages, personal-care items, and other approved products. Purchase or coordinate procurement of products from approved suppliers. Receive, check, and properly store incoming products. Monitor stock levels and prepare purchase/replenishment requirements. Maintain accurate records of stock receipts, sales, returns, wastage, and balances. Operate the shop’s billing/cash system and maintain daily sales and cash records. Ensure that products are sold according to approved prices and company policies. Prevent stock shortages, excess inventory, expiry, damage, and unauthorized transactions. Check product expiry dates and remove expired or damaged products from sale. Keep the shop clean, organized, and hygienic at all times. Provide courteous and efficient service to factory employees. Handle employee queries and complaints professionally and escalate unresolved issues to the supervisor. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales and stock reports. Support periodic stock counting and reconciliation with physical inventory. Maintain proper documentation of invoices, purchase records, and shop expenses. Coordinate with the Administration, Accounts, Procurement, and Welfare teams when required. Ensure compliance with company rules, safety requirements, and internal audit procedures. Support internal and external audits related to the Fair Price Shop. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Cost control Cutting Section Process optimization Production Planning Production Reporting Quality Assurance Sewing Machine Operator Compensation & Other Benefits As per company policy. raw_source_fields.education: Master of Commerce (MCom) Candidates with MBA in HRM or Master’s degree in other discipline may apply with PGDHRM, will be given preference.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1539147&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Master of Commerce (MCom) Candidates with MBA in HRM or Master’s degree in other discipline may apply with PGDHRM, will be given preference. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Automobile, Cement Industry, Furniture Manufacturer, Group of Companies, Manufacturing (Light Engineering and Heavy Industry), Plastic/ Polymer Industry, Real Estate, Steel Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Responsibilities & Context Responsible for recruitment & deployment, staff on-boarding, learning & development initiatives and other assigned duties following office procedure, systems, & practices, culture, climate, structure, operations strategy, and advised by the line manager: Recruitment & Deployment: In close collaboration with the heads Of departments, prepare individual department's recruitment plans and job descriptions are in place for all roles. Assist in preparing job advertisements; arrange job postings, contact applying and coordinate interviews in accordance with the organizational recruitment standards & business needs. Coordinate the recruitment in accordance with the set standard WFP and recruitment policy respectively, and on completion of interviews to check background & references accordingly as & when applicable. Deploy DCW & MCW (workers) on time following the set standard WFP for smooth operations Of the organization. New Staff Onboarding: On confirmation of appointment, handle employee's joining formalities, counseling, performance assessment & job confirmation etc. in appropriate manner. Induction & placement in liaison with other depts., arrange for on-boarding for all newly recruited staff in their first week as per set guidelines, and ensure it goes with org. value, culture, sensibility and confidentiality policy etc. Ensure new team member receives required equipment (official stamp, computer, phone, desk, email addresses, identity cards, business card etc.) on 1st day of reporting and / or with seven days and / or as advised. Staff Development: Consolidate all employees training needs from the annual performance appraisal tools and also address all training requested by line managers. Closely work with HODs for developing the monthly and / or annual training calendar for the review of HR & Admin Manager, and coordinating training program uninterruptedly. Identify suitable trainers or training service provider; act as the focal point for all trainers and training needs. Ensure proper record keeping of all training documents (training request form, attendance, PR & training proposals etc.) Conduct feedback survey after each training, to assess the outcome Of the training, and maintain a database keeping records Of individual staff training information and update it in a regularly basis. Training database/ reports, and prepare the monthly report to share with HR & Admin Manager, and use the database information for preparing ROI. Other Initiatives: Perform any other duties assigned by the line manager time to time. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Recruitment & Selection Talent Acquisition Training Needs Assessment Training Program Coordination Compensation & Other Benefits Performance bonus Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Facilitated training throughout the year. Earn leave encashment annually. Laundry allowance. All benefits to be followed companys policies and / or guidelines. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Munshiganj (Gazaria)

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting
raw_source_fields.age: 24 to 32 years

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1539803&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Group of Companies, Plastic/ Polymer Industry Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 24 to 32 years Experience in a group of companies, manufacturing, distribution, at corporate Head Office will be an advantage. Responsibilities & Context Talukder Group is looking for a responsible, detail-oriented, and proactive Executive / Sr. Executive – Accounts / Treasury to support the day-to-day accounting and treasury operations at its Head Office. The position will be responsible for maintaining financial records, managing cash and bank transactions, supporting fund management, bank reconciliation, and ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting. Key Responsibilities Accounts & Financial Operations Maintain and update books of accounts, ledgers, vouchers, and supporting financial documents. Prepare and verify payment, receipt, journal, and adjustment vouchers. Record daily financial transactions accurately in the accounting/ERP system. Perform bank, cash, and ledger reconciliations on a regular basis. Monitor accounts payable and receivable and ensure timely recording and settlement. Assist in preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports. Ensure proper documentation and compliance with company accounting policies and procedures. Support internal and external audit requirements by providing necessary schedules, documents, and explanations. Treasury & Banking Monitor daily cash and bank balances and prepare regular fund position reports. Handle day-to-day banking transactions, including fund transfers, deposits, withdrawals, and payment processing. Prepare and maintain bank reconciliation statements. Coordinate with banks regarding account-related matters, payment instructions, statements, and other banking requirements. Monitor fund requirements and support timely allocation of funds among business units/companies. Maintain records of bank facilities, loans, LC, BG, and other banking instruments, where applicable. Prepare cash flow and fund requirement statements for management review. Ensure proper authorization and supporting documentation for all treasury transactions. Reporting & Coordination Prepare daily/weekly/monthly treasury and financial reports as required by management. Coordinate with Accounts, Finance, Commercial, Procurement, Sales, and other relevant departments regarding financial transactions. Follow up on outstanding payments, collections, and other financial matters. Assist management in analyzing cash flow, liquidity, and working capital requirements. Perform any other accounts, finance, or treasury-related tasks assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Financial accounting Bank Reconciliation Accounts Payable Receivable Financial Reporting Compensation & Other Benefits Mobile bill Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Other benefits as per company policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Nikunja)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Review and update Treasury operational processes and Oracle modules and develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) in line with ISO standards. Facilitate internal and external audits, support ISO 27001 compliance, and manage ad hoc regulatory reporting and responses to Bangladesh Bank. Review service agreements, legal drafts, and Notes for Approval (NFA) in coordination with Legal, Commercial, Product & Technology, and other relevant teams. Coordinate with Business Finance, Commercial, Product & Technology, and Regulatory & External Affairs on operational issues, financial services, assisted partner settlements, reporting, regulatory requirements, and new product implementation. Coordinate with banks on operational issues, UAT for new products and services, dispute settlement, and fund settlement. Coordinate with MNOs and middleware partners on daily funding modality and assisted partner settlement-related matters as per agreed process. Support regulatory inspections, responses, reporting to Bangladesh Bank, and proposal submissions as required. Facilitate Treasury-related activities for external audits in line with management expectations. Skills & Expertise: Sales & Marketing, Digital Marketing, Facebook marketing, Content Creation Responsibilities & Context Responsibilities & Context: কোম্পানির ট্রাভেল, ভিসা প্রসেসিং, ওয়ার্ক পারমিট ও স্টুডেন্ট ভিসা সংক্রান্ত সেবার মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রমে সহযোগিতা করা। Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp ও অন্যান্য ডিজিটাল প্ল্যাটফর্মে মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা ও নিয়মিত কনটেন্ট প্রচার করা। সম্ভাব্য ক্লায়েন্টদেরসাথে যোগাযোগ করে কোম্পানির বিভিন্ন সার্ভিস সম্পর্কে তথ্য প্রদান করা। সোশ্যাল মিডিয়া থেকে আসা ইনবক্স, কমেন্ট ও কাস্টমার কুয়েরি দ্রুত ও পেশাদারভাবে পরিচালনা করা। নতুন ক্লায়েন্ট/লিড সংগ্রহ করা এবং সংগৃহীত লিডগুলো নিয়মিত ফলো-আপ করা। ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিং ক্যাম্পেইন, বিজ্ঞাপন ও প্রচারণার পরিকল্পনা ও বাস্তবায়নে সহযোগিতা করা। মার্কেটিং কনটেন্ট, পোস্ট, ব্যানার ও ভিডিও তৈরির কাজে টিমকে প্রয়োজনীয় সহযোগিতা করা। বাজারের ট্রেন্ড, প্রতিযোগী প্রতিষ্ঠান ও গ্রাহকদের চাহিদা সম্পর্কে তথ্য সংগ্রহ ও বিশ্লেষণ করা। দৈনিক/সাপ্তাহিক মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রম ও লিডের রিপোর্ট প্রস্তুত করা। বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধির জন্য নতুন মার্কেটিং আইডিয়া ও কৌশল প্রস্তাব করা। কোম্পানির ব্র্যান্ড ইমেজ ও কাস্টমার সার্ভিসের মান বজায় রেখে কাজ করা। প্রয়োজনে অন্যান্য মার্কেটিং ও অফিসিয়াল কাজে টিমকে সহযোগিতা করা। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Sales & Marketing Facebook marketing Visa Processing Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only females are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Naya Paltan)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540203&fc.title: Senior Executive (Marketing & Sales)

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Marketing Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Marketing
raw_source_fields.age: 26 to 45 years Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities – Senior Executive (Marketing & Sales) Develop and execute sales and marketing plans to achieve assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual targets. Generate new leads through digital marketing, referrals, networking, corporate contacts, and other sales channels. Follow up with prospective clients and convert qualified leads into property bookings and sales. Present and explain project details, including location, floor plans, specifications, pricing, payment schedules, and facilities. Conduct client meetings, site visits, property presentations, and project demonstrations. Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers to support repeat business and referrals. Prepare quotations, sales proposals, booking documents, and other necessary sales-related paperwork. Negotiate with clients within approved company policies and coordinate with management for special pricing or payment arrangements. Coordinate with Accounts, Legal, Customer Service, Construction, and Project teams to ensure smooth completion of sales transactions. Maintain accurate records of leads, client communications, follow-ups, bookings, collections, and sales status. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, property prices, customer preferences, and emerging business opportunities. Assist in planning and implementing promotional campaigns, exhibitions, property fairs, corporate presentations, and other marketing activities. Support digital marketing activities, including social media promotions, online campaigns, lead generation, and customer engagement. Prepare regular sales reports, lead conversion reports, collection updates, and market feedback for management. Ensure timely follow-up on customer payments and coordinate with the Accounts Department regarding outstanding installments. Handle customer queries professionally and resolve sales-related issues in coordination with the concerned departments. Participate in sales meetings, training sessions, project briefings, and business development activities. Build and maintain a professional network with individuals, corporate organizations, brokers, property consultants, and other potential business partners. Ensure all sales activities comply with company policies, approved pricing, and applicable procedures. Perform any other sales, marketing, and business-development responsibilities assigned by the management.

Requirements Additional Requirements Age At least 18 years Essential requirements: Education: • Desirable finance, business or administration related diploma. Experience: • Essential previous working experience of at least two years in relevant jobs. • Desirable experience in MSF or other NGOs in developing countries. Languages: • Mission language and local language essential Knowledge: • Essential computer literacy (word, excel, internet) Competencies: • Results and Quality Orientation L2 • Team work and Cooperation L2 • Behavioural Flexibility L2 • Commitment to MSF Principles L2 • Stress Management L3 Responsibilities & Context Main Purpose: Execute administrative and finance related tasks and follow up of project accountancy to support the Project Finance Manager following MSF standard and procedures, in order to ensure legal compliance and keep a strict control over monetary resources to achieve project objectives. Accountabilities: • Implementing cash management procedures in order to ensure the highest control and security, assisting the Project Fin Manager in the prevision of monthly treasury and planning in order to en-sure the coverage of daily needs, advances on salaries, payroll, etc. • Processing the payment to suppliers and keep strict on all documentation involved, informing the administration manager of any sort of disparity • Carrying out all accounting tasks and activities, classifying, preparing and filing of all accounting pieces in accounting software, in order to ensure strict control of all expenditures and the reliability of statements and documentation. • Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, etc.), supporting the Accountancy Manager (ACMA) in translating documents into local language and assisting in meetings upon request. • Any other administrative task delegated by the Accountancy Manager (ACMA) MSF Section/Context Specific Accountabilities: MSF Cox’s Bazar office is considered as sub office to Dhaka Intersection Support Team (IST), therefore the Finance Assistant will be considered as part of IST finance team member, and for any reason the Finance coordinator can request the Fin Assistant to join IST at Dhaka any time (support, cover gap, etc). • To help the Finance coordinator on the execution of the IST objective by supporting with the proper advise on finance when needed. • Cash Management: To handle 5 (Five) cash box and entry book in cash register UF. • Processing payment of big volume of local purchase for OCA, OCB & OCP mission and workshop Payment. • Encode all the transection into UF. • VAT & TAX challan summary report for different FD’s and organize softcopy of the challan in the finance share folder (PD, PIT & Suppliers). • Challans share to Supplier’s as per need. • Employee & Supplier/Vendor TDS Certificate Download • Organize monthly IST BKK and send to Dhaka IST • To Scan OCA BKK (Heavy duty scanner availability) • To prépare monthly 6 (six) bank reconciliation for IST accounts • Monthly checking IMS PD tracker, uploading in UF & share with all the IST IMS • Prepare monthly medical Tracking sheet & share to Medical • Book adjusting entries in UF for IMS cost reimbursement. • Monthly VAT & TDS deposit information update in the Compliance Overview tracker. • Prepare monthly IST VAT return report with issuing Mushok 6.6 • Monthly workshop related expense report share to IST Workshop Manager. • Bank Signatory add documents preparation for CXB IST • Collaboration with OC’s when they need or ask for. • Help to other work as per need, budget preparation (FD6 & MSF internal), VAT return submission in NBR site, financial statement preparation. • To perform any other task delegated by Finco, and to be flexible to support on some HR tasks. Support to HR & Admin Team: • Support IST HR/Admin team with accommodation and housekeeping arrangements • Monthly IR submission for Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop. • Check the inventory align with Supply Sup. And physical check the stock in present and make Forecast of Monthly Consuption for quarterly basis and submit (Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop) • Distribute ID Cards and Ribbon to colleagues (as per need). • Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, leave form, etc.) • Sending staff files (signed contracts, signed JDs, leave form, etc) to HR Assistant/HRM to encode them in Homere. • Additional HR/ Admin tasks delegated by the IST HRCo/Dep HRCo. Compensation & Other Benefits Contract and Benefit: • Fixed term contract for 06 months . Salary according to level 6 (Six) of the internal MSF salary grid (BDT 85,500 Gross). Salary is non-negotiable. Income tax deduction from salary based on current income tax rule. • 2 annual leave days per month worked. • Weekly 2 holidays. • Medical Reimbursement for employee and direct dependents based on Health Care Policy- Locally Recruited Staff. Others: There will be no provisions for relocation. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Coxs Bazar

Requirements
Additional Requirements
Essential requirements:
Education:
• Desirable finance, business or administration related diploma.
Experience:
• Essential previous working experience of at least two years in relevant jobs.
• Desirable experience in MSF or other NGOs in developing countries.
Languages:
• Mission language and local language essential
Knowledge:
• Essential computer literacy (word, excel, internet)
Competencies:
• Results and Quality Orientation L2
• Team work and Cooperation L2
• Behavioural Flexibility L2
• Commitment to MSF Principles L2
• Stress Management L3
Responsibilities & Context
Main Purpose:
Execute administrative and finance related tasks and follow up of project accountancy to support the Project Finance Manager following MSF standard and procedures, in order to ensure legal compliance and keep a strict control over monetary resources to achieve project objectives.
Accountabilities:
• Implementing cash management procedures in order to ensure the highest control and security, assisting the Project Fin Manager in the prevision of monthly treasury and planning in order to en-sure the coverage of daily needs, advances on salaries, payroll, etc.
• Processing the payment to suppliers and keep strict on all documentation involved, informing the administration manager of any sort of disparity
• Carrying out all accounting tasks and activities, classifying, preparing and filing of all accounting pieces in accounting software, in order to ensure strict control of all expenditures and the reliability of statements and documentation.
• Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, etc.), supporting the Accountancy Manager (ACMA) in translating documents into local language and assisting in meetings upon request.
• Any other administrative task delegated by the Accountancy Manager (ACMA)
MSF Section/Context Specific Accountabilities:
MSF Cox’s Bazar office is considered as sub office to Dhaka Intersection Support Team (IST), therefore the Finance Assistant will be considered as part of IST finance team member, and for any reason the Finance coordinator can request the Fin Assistant to join IST at Dhaka any time (support, cover gap, etc).
• To help the Finance coordinator on the execution of the IST objective by supporting with the proper advise on finance when needed.
• Cash Management: To handle 5 (Five) cash box and entry book in cash register UF.
• Processing payment of big volume of local purchase for OCA, OCB & OCP mission and workshop Payment.
• Encode all the transection into UF.
• VAT & TAX challan summary report for different FD’s and organize softcopy of the challan in the finance share folder (PD, PIT & Suppliers).
• Challans share to Supplier’s as per need.
• Employee & Supplier/Vendor TDS Certificate Download
• Organize monthly IST BKK and send to Dhaka IST
• To Scan OCA BKK (Heavy duty scanner availability)
• To prépare monthly 6 (six) bank reconciliation for IST accounts
• Monthly checking IMS PD tracker, uploading in UF & share with all the IST IMS
• Prepare monthly medical Tracking sheet & share to Medical
• Book adjusting entries in UF for IMS cost reimbursement.
• Monthly VAT & TDS deposit information update in the Compliance Overview tracker.
• Prepare monthly IST VAT return report with issuing Mushok 6.6
• Monthly workshop related expense report share to IST Workshop Manager.
• Bank Signatory add documents preparation for CXB IST
• Collaboration with OC’s when they need or ask for.
• Help to other work as per need, budget preparation (FD6 & MSF internal), VAT return submission in NBR site, financial statement preparation.
• To perform any other task delegated by Finco, and to be flexible to support on some HR tasks.
Support to HR & Admin Team:
• Support IST HR/Admin team with accommodation and housekeeping arrangements
• Monthly IR submission for Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop.
• Check the inventory align with Supply Sup. And physical check the stock in present and make Forecast of Monthly Consuption for quarterly basis and submit (Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop)
• Distribute ID Cards and Ribbon to colleagues (as per need).
• Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, leave form, etc.)
• Sending staff files (signed contracts, signed JDs, leave form, etc) to HR Assistant/HRM to encode them in Homere.
• Additional HR/ Admin tasks delegated by the IST HRCo/Dep HRCo.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Contract and Benefit:
• Fixed term contract for 06 months. Salary according to level 6 (Six) of the internal MSF salary grid (BDT 85,500 Gross). Salary is non-negotiable. Income tax deduction from salary based on current income tax rule.
• 2 annual leave days per month worked.
• Weekly 2 holidays.
• Medical Reimbursement for employee and direct dependents based on Health Care Policy- Locally Recruited Staff.
Others: There will be no provisions for relocation.

Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Job Location
Cox`s Bazar

Application process:
Online application: Please submit your application online at the link below by 07/10/2026. You need to attach your CV and Certificates in a PDF format during application.
No hard copies will be accepted for this position.
Important Notes:
• Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
• Only online applications will be accepted. Any hard copies or soft copies via e-mail (unless it has been requested for) will be discarded.
• Only Bangladeshi citizens will be considered for this position.
• No monetary, goods or service offers, nor favouritism, will be tolerated in a recruitment process. Any illicit solicitations can be reported to the justice system. MSF reserves the right to refuse any candidate having benefited from such acts and will stop collaboration with any workers involved in such acts.
• Our recruitment process is fully transparent and follows standardized evaluation criteria.
• We strictly ensure data protection by handling all candidate information confidentially and in line with applicable policies.
• We are committed to safeguarding principles, ensuring a safe, respectful, and ethical environment.
• Médecins Sans Frontières is an equal opportunity employer and encourages diversity, equity and inclusion. Following that we strongly encourage applications from female and individuals from ethnically diverse backgrounds.
Address:
5th Floor, Khawaja Palace, Plot N. 76, Ro-11, Banani, Dhaka-1213, Bangladesh.

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Advertising Agency, BPO/ Data Entry Firm, Business-to-Business (B2B) Software and Services Startup, IT Enabled Service, Software Company Additional Requirements Age At least 20 years 3–5 years of hands-on experience in E-commerce and Marketplace Management. Strong practical experience managing Amazon Seller Central, including FBA/FBM, listings, inventory, orders, pricing, and account health. Proven experience with Amazon, Walmart, eBay, and TikTok Shop or similar major marketplaces. Experience in product research, product sourcing, competitor analysis, and identifying profitable products. Strong knowledge of product listing optimization, marketplace SEO, keyword research, and conversion optimization. Hands-on experience with Amazon PPC, including campaign setup, keyword targeting, bidding, budget management, and performance optimization. Experience managing inventory, pricing, fulfillment, returns, and marketplace operations across multiple channels. Strong understanding of marketplace policies, compliance, account health, listing restrictions, and issue resolution. Experience using tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Keepa, Data Dive, or similar e-commerce tools. Strong analytical skills with the ability to use Excel/Google Sheets and marketplace reports to track sales, advertising, inventory, and profitability. Ability to independently identify problems, analyze performance, and implement data-driven strategies to improve sales and profitability. Experience working with US/UK/Canada marketplaces will be an advantage. Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Responsibilities & Context Manage day-to-day operations of Amazon, Walmart, eBay, and TikTok Shop accounts. Manage Amazon Seller Central & Vendor Central , including listings, inventory, orders, shipments, and account health. Handle Amazon FBA inventory, shipment planning, restocking, storage, and fulfillment-related issues. Conduct product and competitor research to identify market and sales opportunities. Perform keyword research and optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, and product content . Manage Amazon A+ Content and Brand Store updates and optimization. Plan, manage, and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns , including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display. Monitor and optimize ACoS, ROAS, TACoS, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and advertising performance . Manage Walmart Marketplace listings, inventory, pricing, orders, and account performance. Manage eBay listings, product information, pricing, promotions, orders, and seller performance. Manage TikTok Shop products, inventory, orders, promotions, and marketplace operations. Monitor account health, policy compliance, listing violations, suppressed listings, and marketplace warnings . Analyze sales, traffic, conversion, advertising, inventory, and profitability data using Excel/Google Sheets and marketplace reports . Monitor competitor pricing and marketplace trends and recommend appropriate pricing strategies. Identify sales and operational issues and take timely corrective actions. Prepare regular marketplace performance reports with actionable insights. Coordinate with content, design, customer service, warehouse, and management teams when required. Stay updated with changes in Amazon, Walmart, eBay, and TikTok Shop policies and marketplace features . Skills & Expertise Amazon FBA Amazon Marketing Amazon Seller Central Ecommerce PPC Marketing tiktok Walmart Walmart Marketing Compensation & Other Benefits Performance bonus,Over time allowance Festival Bonus: 2 All public holidays of the Bangladesh Government. Dynamic, innovative work environment. Company-sponsored professional growth and training opportunities. Parental leaves. A safe, respectful, and family-oriented work environment. Manage social media pages, online inquiries, customer communication, lead follow-up and digital promotional activities. Analyze campaign performance, customer data and digital marketing results and prepare regular reports for management. Manage and monitor the company's CRM, software, website and other digital business systems on a regular basis. Ensure proper data entry, data management, data accuracy and smooth flow of information within the software and CRM. Monitor the complete software workflow from front-end user interface to back-end/admin panel operations and identify any functional or technical issues. Monitor admin panels, dashboards, databases, user access, permissions and system-generated information. Check whether information and data are properly transferred and synchronized between front-end, back-end, CRM, website and other connected platforms. Coordinate with developers regarding software development, CRM updates, website improvements, API integration, database-related requirements and new features. Test new software features, website updates, CRM changes and system improvements before final implementation and provide proper feedback. Monitor pending technical tasks, bugs, corrections, updates and development requirements and ensure timely follow-up. Understand the overall workflow of software and digital systems and identify areas where automation or system improvements can make business operations more efficient. Monitor website functionality, lead forms, customer journey and digital user experience and report issues for improvement. Maintain digital records, campaign data, leads, customer information, software requirements and technical issue reports accurately. Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports related to digital marketing, leads, software performance and system activities. Coordinate between management, marketing, operations, developers and IT teams to ensure smooth implementation of digital and software-related tasks. Stay updated with digital marketing trends, software tools, CRM systems, website technologies and new digital platforms. Handle multiple digital marketing and software-related tasks independently and complete assigned responsibilities within deadlines. Work remotely while maintaining regular communication, reporting and coordination with the management and concerned teams. Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Additional Requirements Age 22 to 26 years Only Male Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who is: Highly organised and responsible Good with Excel/Google Sheets and numbers Strong at planning and follow-up Comfortable managing factory workers and suppliers Able to solve problems independently Comfortable dealing with logistics companies and government offices Experienced in manufacturing, supply chain, procurement or export Experience with wood products, furniture, homeware or Amazon/FBA is a plus. The Role You will work primarily from our Khulna factory and report directly to the UK-based management team. Because the business is still being established, this is an opportunity to help build the systems and processes from the ground up , rather than simply maintain an existing operation. The aim is to create a reliable operation where production, inventory, quality, purchasing and export are organised and predictable as the business grows. Responsibilities & Context About Stonewell Supply We currently have a wood manufacturing factory in Khulna, Bangladesh , and are in the process of formally establishing and developing the wider Stonewell Supply business. We are a UK-based company developing wooden homeware products for international markets, initially selling through Amazon UK. We are looking for a Supply Chain to help us build and organise the systems needed to grow the business. Location: Khulna, Bangladesh Responsibilities You will help manage the supply chain from raw materials to production, finished products and export . Production planning — decide what needs to be produced, when and in what quantities. Inventory — track raw wood, work-in-progress, finished products and packaging. Demand planning — use sales data to plan future production and avoid stockouts. Quality control — coordinate inspections and reduce defects and rework. Wood & moisture management — monitor drying, storage and moisture levels. Packaging — ensure the correct packaging is available for production. Export & logistics — coordinate shipments from the Khulna factory to the UK. Documentation — manage invoices, packing lists, export paperwork and records. Business & export registration — assist with business registration, trade licence, ERC, chamber registration, export-related requirements and renewals. Cost control — track production and landed costs. Supplier management — monitor suppliers for price, quality and reliability. Reporting — provide a clear weekly report on production, inventory, QC, shipments, costs and problems. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Demand Planning Inventory Management Procurement Management System Production Planning Quality Control Supply Chain Management Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Khulna, Khulna (Khulna Sadar)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Marketing Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Marketing Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology,BRAC University,East West University,American International University Bangladesh,Primeasia University students will get preference Additional Requirements Age 21 to 40 years Responsibilities & Context About Migration Solution Migration Solution is a Bangladesh-based immigration consultancy serving clients since 2017, with a particular focus on investor migration and family migration. We help individuals and families understand migration opportunities and coordinate their application and documentation processes. We are looking for organised, enthusiastic interns who want practical experience in client service, immigration processing, and office administration. Key Responsibilities Communicate with clients professionally through phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and in-person meetings. Share verified immigration news, programme updates, and service information approved by the supervising team. Follow up with prospective and existing clients regarding enquiries, required documents, appointments, and application progress. Assist clients in understanding document checklists and collecting the required information. Organise, scan, label, and maintain client documents and application files. Assist the processing team with application preparation, data entry, and document completeness checks. Prepare draft client agreements using approved templates and coordinate review, signing, and recordkeeping. Maintain updated client records, follow-up schedules, and daily activity reports. Support meeting arrangements and routine office administration. Protect client confidentiality and handle personal information carefully. Refer questions about eligibility, fees, legal matters, or visa outcomes to the responsible consultant. Candidate Requirements Currently studying toward or recently completed a bachelor’s degree in any discipline. Good communication skills in Bangla and basic professional English. Basic proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and online document management. Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and willingness to learn. A polite, responsible, punctual, and client-focused attitude. Ability to attend the office regularly from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM on assigned working days. Previous experience is not required; freshers are encouraged to apply. What You Will Gain Practical training in client communication and immigration documentation. Exposure to investor and family migration services. Guidance from experienced team members. A monthly allowance. An internship completion certificate upon successful completion. Consideration for future employment, subject to performance and available vacancies. Skills & Expertise Sales & Marketing Call Center Operation Telemarketing Communication and interpersonal skill Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Corporate Marketing Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context
Migration Solution is a Bangladesh-based immigration consultancy serving clients since 2017, with a particular focus on investor migration and family migration. We help individuals and families understand migration opportunities and coordinate their application and documentation processes.
We are looking for organised, enthusiastic interns who want practical experience in client service, immigration processing, and office administration.
Communicate with clients professionally through phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and in-person meetings.
Share verified immigration news, programme updates, and service information approved by the supervising team.
Follow up with prospective and existing clients regarding enquiries, required documents, appointments, and application progress.
Assist clients in understanding document checklists and collecting the required information.
Organise, scan, label, and maintain client documents and application files.
Assist the processing team with application preparation, data entry, and document completeness checks.
Prepare draft client agreements using approved templates and coordinate review, signing, and recordkeeping.
Maintain updated client records, follow-up schedules, and daily activity reports.
Support meeting arrangements and routine office administration.
Protect client confidentiality and handle personal information carefully.
Refer questions about eligibility, fees, legal matters, or visa outcomes to the responsible consultant.
Currently studying toward or recently completed a bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
Good communication skills in Bangla and basic professional English.
Basic proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and online document management.
Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and willingness to learn.
A polite, responsible, punctual, and client-focused attitude.
Ability to attend the office regularly from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM on assigned working days.
Previous experience is not required; freshers are encouraged to apply.
Practical training in client communication and immigration documentation.
Exposure to investor and family migration services.
Guidance from experienced team members.
A monthly allowance.
An internship completion certificate upon successful completion.
Consideration for future employment, subject to performance and available vacancies.

Work at office

Responsibilities & Context WE’RE HIRING | Sales & Marketing Executive | Real Estate Malum Housing Ltd., a concern of Malum Group, is expanding its team for upcoming residential projects at Rajuk Purbachal New Town, Dhaka. We are looking for smart, responsible, and result-oriented professionals to join our growing team. POSITION: Senior Executive / Executive – Sales & Marketing Vacancy: 2 Key Responsibilities: Handle customer inquiries and provide professional guidance regarding residential flats, plots, and real estate projects. Generate, manage, and follow up with potential clients. Conduct client meetings, property presentations, and project briefings. Arrange and manage site visits for prospective buyers. Convert potential leads into successful flat and plot sales. Maintain regular communication and build long-term client relationships. Coordinate telemarketing and lead management activities. Maintain and update CRM systems and customer databases. Monitor market trends, customer demand, and competitor activities. Prepare daily and weekly sales reports for management. Requirements Education Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Management Must have an MBA degree from a recognized university. Experience At most 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Group of Companies Additional Requirements Age 23 to 28 years Only Female Required Personal Qualities The ideal candidate should be: Honest, responsible, disciplined, and punctual. Professional, polite, and well-organized. Capable of handling responsibilities independently. Proactive and solution-oriented. Able to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines. Skilled in communication, coordination, and problem-solving. Comfortable working with different departments and levels of management. Willing to learn, improve, and take on additional responsibilities when necessary. Basic experience in Administration, Office Management, or a related field will be an advantage. Candidates with limited professional experience may also apply if they have strong learning ability, responsibility, and a genuine interest in administrative management. Good communication skills in both English and Bengali. Good working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, Email, and other common office applications. Responsibilities & Context ESNL GROUP is looking for a competent, responsible, organized, and dedicated Admin Executive to support and manage the overall administrative activities of the organization efficiently and professionally. We are seeking a candidate who is enthusiastic about developing a career in administration and capable of maintaining office discipline, coordinating between departments, supporting management, and ensuring smooth day-to-day administrative operations. Key Responsibilities Manage and coordinate the day-to-day administrative activities of ESNL GROUP. Maintain office discipline, attendance, and smooth operational procedures. Coordinate effectively among employees, departments, and Top Management. Prepare and maintain official letters, notices, reports, meeting documents, records, and other administrative documentation. Assist in organizing meetings, appointments, official programs, and management schedules. Monitor office assets, equipment, stationery, supplies, and other administrative requirements. Support the implementation of company policies, procedures, and management instructions. Collect necessary information from different departments and prepare reports for Management. Maintain proper confidentiality of sensitive company information and official documents. Identify administrative issues and take appropriate initiatives to resolve them in coordination with Management. Maintain proper filing, documentation, and record-keeping systems. Support communication and coordination with external organizations, service providers, and other stakeholders when required. Take proactive initiatives to make the organization’s administrative operations more disciplined, transparent, efficient, and professional. Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540127&fc.source_content: Requirements Additional Requirements Required Skills and Abilities Conduct research, including use of commercial computer-based research services. Communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, to a diverse audience. Plan, organize and prioritize work. Assign and supervise the work of others. Demonstrate the highest level of ethical behavior. Remain flexible in order to adapt to changes in work environment. Study and apply new information, and take initiative. Excellent time-management, problem-prevention and problem-solving skills. Work accurately with close attention to detail. Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information. Work effectively, professionally and tactfully with diverse workforce, team leaders, senior staff, and outside companies and public agencies. Possess a work ethic that includes neatness, punctuality and accuracy. Exhibit a professional, businesslike appearance and demeanor. Basic computer skills, including e-mail, word processing and spreadsheets. Excellent interpersonal skills to facilitate interaction with the workforce. Candidates having hospitality background are preferred Responsibilities & Context POSITION SUMMARY The Human Resources (“HR”) Manager has overall responsibility for the HR function as it relates to all Hotel Sarina Dhaka team members, including employee relations, compensation and benefits administration, development, implementation and administration of human resources programs and employment policies, personnel record-keeping, workers compensation and team member safety issues, training and workforce development, and compliance with HR laws and regulations of the government of Bangladesh. The HR Manager performs advanced professional work advising Hotel Sarina Dhaka team leaders and team members on the application of employment, benefits and workers compensation laws and regulations and employment policies in the contexts of hiring, discipline, employment termination, training, compensation, benefits, leave, equal opportunity and other human resources issues. The HR Manager must be open and available to discuss human resources matters with the entire workforce. The HR Manager reports to the General Manager, address employee safety issues, and oversee third party administrator and outside counsel in the handling of workers compensation matters. The HR Manager supervises the Organizational Development & Training function. The Human Resources Manager also performs such other functions as may be assigned by the Management / General Manager. RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES OF HUMAN RESOURCES MANAGER Maintain knowledge of and ensure compliance with employment-related laws and regulations of the government of Bangladesh Manage actions and proceedings brought against Hotel Sarina Dhaka arising in connection with employment, benefits and workers compensation issues, including preparation of all Polices Maintain all personnel files, records, Police Reports background investigation results, and other personnel records, and ensure Hotel Sarina Dhaka is in compliance with all laws and regulations and demonstrates “best practices” in regard to personnel information management. Provide leadership in effective conflict resolution for all personnel. Analyze benefits options and cost alternatives for providing employee benefits, recommend benefits program modifications and implement approved benefits modifications. Work with senior management to craft consistent, equitable and competitive compensation and incentives. Develop and implement human resources programs and policies and periodically update Team Member and Team Leader Handbooks. Serve as a resource for team leaders in handling employee issues and assist them in counseling employees, conducting evaluations, staff training, problem-solving and consensus-building. Serve as a resource for all team members by being available and accessible to discuss all human resources related issues. Oversee the Organizational Development & Training function and develop employee training programs. Maintain inter- and intradepartmental work flow by providing information to and cooperating with co-workers. Assist in hiring by providing job descriptions and advertisements, and in the case of hiring of senior team leaders, by screening and interviewing candidates. Work with the Management, and inform on matters involving benefits, employee safety and workers compensation issues. Oversee handling of employment-related inquiries, such as employment verification requests and unemployment compensation inquiries and proceedings. Chair/serve on various Hotel Sarina Dhaka committees, as well as outside human resources or industry-related groups. Develop, implement and participate in employee recognition programs. Enhance job performance by applying up-to-date professional and technical knowledge gained by attending seminars and conferences and reviewing professional publications. Perform other duties as assigned by the Management/ General Manager ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS Prepare and maintain accurate records, files and reports, including responsibility for maintaining personnel records. Organize and work independently on multiple assigned tasks/projects and complete assignments within specified deadlines. Communicate effectively verbally and in writing to all levels of staff and management, outside officials and agencies, and the public, expressing ideas and instructions clearly and concisely. Compile and analyze complex information, and research and develop solutions to complex issues. Work well under pressure. Accurately follow verbal and written directions from senior management. Advise on employment statutes, rules, regulations and policies affecting team members. Meet with and assist Hotel Sarina Dhaka team leaders in planning and directing activities, explaining and implementing decisions, and resolving significant issues involving team members. Recommend, develop, interpret and clarify personnel procedures and policies. Conduct research regarding employment issues, benefits, workers compensation and personnel procedures and, working with General Manager, apply the conclusions to personnel policies and practices. Assist in hiring, including developing job descriptions and job advertisements, and screening and interviewing candidates. Develop, implement and manage a centralized recruiting process. Demonstrate skills in consensus-building and mediation in order to constructively address employee conflicts. Demonstrate skills critical for managerial success including leadership, decisiveness, flexibility, sound business judgment, and highly developed personal, analytical and communication skills. WORK ENVIRONMENT Ability to work in an office setting. Position may require extended hours including evenings and weekends, travel to multiple work sites. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Computer Skills Human Resource Management Problem-solving skill Recruitment & Selection Time Management Employment Status Full Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Cement Industry, Group of Companies, Third Party Auditor (Quality, Health, Environment, Compliance Additional Requirements Age 30 to 40 years Only Male Candidates having FMCG experience will be given preference. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently, taking full responsibilities for sales audit function. Strong decision-making ability, problem identification and resolution. Mentality to visit across the country as it requires frequent field trip to analyze the real market setup. Ability to perform duties and respond to request in a timely manner. Attitude to work as a team and take the leadership if it requires. Strong reporting skill and have excellent command over Microsoft office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Responsibilities & Context Perform market audit to ensure companys guidelines around sales processes comply with regulatory standards set by Management. As a representative, contact the responsible authority with relevant information for compensation and follow its disposition recommendation regarding distribution product damage. Assessing suspicious claims from the distribution chain and physically inspects the impairment to find out the real scenario. Identifying the nature of market backed damage & come up with specific recommendations to minimize that product damage percentage. Ensuring proper segmentation of damage products based on their damage nature as per the guideline provided by authority. Prepare reports, commentaries based on practical market visits and present findings and recommendations on those issues. Other duties and assignments as necessary. raw_source_fields.age: At least 26 years Only Male ফ্যাক্টরি HR ম্যানেজমেন্ট ও সোশ্যাল কমপ্লায়েন্স বিষয়ে বাস্তব জ্ঞান। SEDEX/SMETA এবং BSCI অডিট পরিচালনার অভিজ্ঞতা।শ্রম আইন, কর্মক্ষেত্র নীতি ও কর্মী সম্পর্ক বিষয়ে ভালো জ্ঞান।চাপের মধ্যে অডিট পরিচালনা ও স্বাধীনভাবে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা। Responsibilities & Context ফ্যাক্টরির দৈনন্দিন HR ও পার্সোনেল কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা। কর্মচারীদের রেকর্ড, উপস্থিতি, ছুটি, বেতন-সংক্রান্ত ডকুমেন্টেশন ও HR ফাইল সংরক্ষণ করা। বাংলাদেশ শ্রম আইন ও প্রযোজ্য ফ্যাক্টরি বিধিমালা অনুযায়ী কমপ্লায়েন্স নিশ্চিত করা। নিয়োগ, অনবোর্ডিং, কর্মী সম্পর্ক ও শৃঙ্খলামূলক প্রক্রিয়া পরিচালনা করা। HR ও কমপ্লায়েন্স ডকুমেন্টেশন প্রস্তুত ও সংরক্ষণ করা। সোশ্যাল কমপ্লায়েন্স ও এথিক্যাল ট্রেড অডিটের জন্য ফ্যাক্টরিকে প্রস্তুত ও সমন্বয় করা। SEDEX/SMETA, BSCI এবং অন্যান্য কাস্টমার/সোশ্যাল কমপ্লায়েন্স অডিট পরিচালনা ও মোকাবিলার বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকা। অডিটের পর কারেকটিভ ও প্রিভেন্টিভ অ্যাকশন (CAPA) সঠিকভাবে বাস্তবায়ন ও বজায় রাখা। নিয়মিত অভ্যন্তরীণ কমপ্লায়েন্স চেক করা এবং উন্নয়নের ক্ষেত্র চিহ্নিত করা। কাস্টমার ও থার্ড-পার্টি অডিটের জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় রেকর্ড ও ডকুমেন্টেশন সংরক্ষণ করা। ফ্যাক্টরি ম্যানেজমেন্ট, প্রোডাকশন ও অন্যান্য বিভাগের সাথে HR ও কমপ্লায়েন্স বিষয়ে সমন্বয় করা। ফ্যাক্টরির HR ও সোশ্যাল কমপ্লায়েন্স স্ট্যান্ডার্ডের ধারাবাহিক উন্নয়ন ও টেকসইতা নিশ্চিত করা। কর্মচারী সম্পর্ক, কর্মক্ষমতা এবং কর্মক্ষেত্রের সমস্যা সমাধানে ব্যবস্থাপকদের সহায়তা করা। কেপিআই (KPI) নির্ধারণ, মূল্যায়ন দৈনন্দিন HR ও পার্সোনেল কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা। কর্মচারীদের রেকর্ড, উপস্থিতি, ছুটি, বেতন-সংক্রান্ত ডকুমেন্টেশন ও HR ফাইল সংরক্ষণ করা। বাংলাদেশ শ্রম আইন ও প্রযোজ্য ফ্যাক্টরি বিধিমালা অনুযায়ী কমপ্লায়েন্স নিশ্চিত করা। নিয়োগ, অনবোর্ডিং, কর্মী সম্পর্ক ও শৃঙ্খলামূলক প্রক্রিয়া পরিচালনা করা। HR ও কমপ্লায়েন্স ডকুমেন্টেশন প্রস্তুত ও সংরক্ষণ করা। সোশ্যাল কমপ্লায়েন্স ও এথিক্যাল ট্রেড অডিটের জন্য ফ্যাক্টরিকে প্রস্তুত ও সমন্বয় করা। SEDEX/SMETA, BSCI এবং অন্যান্য কাস্টমার/সোশ্যাল কমপ্লায়েন্স অডিট পরিচালনা ও মোকাবিলার বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকা। অডিটের পর কারেকটিভ ও প্রিভেন্টিভ অ্যাকশন (CAPA) সঠিকভাবে প্রোডাকশন ও অন্যান্য বিভাগের সাথে HR ও কমপ্লায়েন্স বিষয়ে সমন্বয় করা। ফ্যাক্টরির HR ও সোশ্যাল কমপ্লায়েন্স স্ট্যান্ডার্ডের ধারাবাহিক উন্নয়ন ও টেকসইতা নিশ্চিত করা। কর্মচারী সম্পর্ক, কর্মক্ষমতা এবং
