Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Diagnostic Centre, Healthcare Startup, Hospital, Pharmaceutical/Medicine Companies Additional Requirements Age 22 to 35 years Candidates with experience as a Medical Representative (MR/MPO) will be given preference. Both "male and female" candidates are encouraged to apply. Job Location: Dhaka and all divisional cities across Bangladesh. Excellent verbal articulation, advanced negotiation tactics, and high-impact corporate presentation skills. Strong capacity to convince, build rapport, and handle objections when dealing with high-profile senior medical specialists, clinical administrators, and pharmacy managers. Proactive self-starter, target-driven mind, tech-savvy, and structurally capable of working independently in the field under pressure. Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities Regularly visit private and government hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centers, and individual doctors to establish strategic healthcare partnerships. Build professional institutional relationships and negotiate Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) and corporate partnership agreements with hospital authorities and medical practitioners. Collect, compile, and maintain highly accurate doctor professional information, core specializations, consultation fees, chamber schedules, and clinical service details. Smoothly onboard new partner hospitals and independent doctors onto the platform system to ensure a robust provider database. Coordinate proactively with partner hospitals and doctors regarding incoming patient appointments and daily service availability. Maintain consistent communication, trust, and outstanding long-term relationships with existing healthcare partners to prevent churn. Identify and capitalize on new strategic partnership opportunities in Dhaka City and gradually scale operations across all 64 districts of Bangladesh. Prepare and submit regular, structured reports detailing hospital visits, executive meetings, signed MoUs, newly onboarded partners, and pending follow-ups. Regularly visit retail and wholesale pharmacies to verify medicine availability, analyze market pricing lists, and onboard strategic pharmacy partners into our digital pharmacy support ecosystem. Willingness to travel extensively within country and when required internationally. Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the management from time to time. Job Context: BookingGlobalDoctor.com is a premier, tech-driven enterprise healthcare platform and medical travel network operating via an integrated mobile application and website. We seamlessly connect nationwide patients with partner doctors, hospitals, diagnostic centers, and pharmacies. We are expanding our ground acquisition operations and looking for highly motivated, energetic, and result-oriented professionals to join our corporate growth team. Skills & Expertise Business Development Communication and interpersonal skill Institutional Sales Proficiency in English and Bangla Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540445&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education B.Sc. in Textile Engineering / Fashion Designing / related discipline from a recognized institution. Candidates having knowledge of Seamless Knitting/Seamless Garments will be preferred. Experience At most 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Garments, Textile, Group of Companies Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 26 to 30 years Only Male Basic knowledge of inventory and store management. Basic knowledge of 5S and warehouse/store practices. Basic knowledge of ERP/software-based inventory management will be an advantage. Understanding of garments/textile production processes. Good numerical and analytical ability. Strong attention to detail.Self-driven and responsible. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Positive mindset and willingness to learn. Ability to work with different departments and under pressure. Experience: 0–6 months / Freshers are encouraged to apply. Internship or practical experience in store, inventory or garments/textile operations will be an advantage. Responsibilities & Context Assist in the day-to-day operation and management of the Seamless Store . Receive, check, arrange and issue raw materials, accessories and other store items according to approved requirements. Maintain proper inventory records, stock registers and system records . Support accurate stock receiving, issuing, transfer and reconciliation . Monitor stock levels and communicate shortages or excess inventory to the concerned authority. Ensure proper identification, tagging, storage and preservation of materials. Follow FIFO/FEFO principles wherever applicable. Assist in conducting regular physical stock counting and reconciliation. Maintain proper housekeeping and 5S practices within the store. Support reduction of material wastage, loss and inventory discrepancies. Coordinate with Production, Planning, Knitting, Technical, Procurement and Accounts departments regarding material requirements. Assist in maintaining proper documentation for material receiving and issuing. Ensure materials are stored safely and systematically to facilitate easy identification and retrieval. Support implementation of best practices for inventory and store management . Perform any other duties assigned by the management. Skills & Expertise Fabric Store Other Relevant Skills Inventory Management Stock Reconciliation FIFO Compensation & Other Benefits Gratuity Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Other Benefits: As per company policy Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Gazipur (Kashimpur)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540349&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Masters degree in Business Administration, Economics, Procurement, Supply Chain Management or similar degree, or equivalent professional qualification (intermediate CIPS) Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Age At least 25 years At least 2 years’ experience in Procurement or Supply Chain Management. Ability to read and write in Bangla and English. The position requires ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally up to 10% of the time Can-do attitude, Results-oriented approach, Proactive mindset, Quick learner, Team player, Focus on impact, etc. Ability to work under stressful condition and adaptive to local culture and situation. Must be able to do multiple tasks and willingness to travel in various locations of BRCR as required. Responsibilities & Context Position Purpose: This Purpose of Position will be used in the WVI or local Careers site, and if applicable, advertisements. Please describe the role in 2-3 concise sentences. Focus on the core of what this role is supposed to achieve. Describe the purpose of this position and how this position contributes to achieving department objectives and the management and performance of others. Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the Supply Chain function to ensure the timely, compliant, and cost-effective procurement and delivery of goods and services that support World Vision’s programs and operations. Lead and develop the Supply Chain team while driving process improvement, standardization, and value-for-money initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and stewardship of resources. Through effective supply chain management, the role contributes to the achievement of organizational objectives and World Vision’s Child Well-Being Outcomes. Key Responsibilities: Business Requirements: Understand the department's business requirements and apply in the day-to-day work. Planning: Advise and seek approval of internal customers of modifications from original requests. Facilitates across all parties the timely resolution of issues that could impact meeting the needs of the requestor and communities. Identify alternative supply sources for materials / services not under contract Work with Logistics to ensure safe delivery and receipt of ordered materials Resolve conflicts with deliveries and suppliers Strategic Sourcing Execute the Market Assessment and Supplier Pre-Qualification process as per the set guidelines based on the set guidelines for the assigned categories. Manage the RFQ/RFP Process including baselines & price survey methodologies as per the approved framework for the assigned categories. Lead negotiations for the assigned Categories. Supervise the Sourcing events Filed Offices and Assistance work relating to sourcing. Preparation of Procurement Committee submission documents to ensure their comprehensiveness to allow an informed decision making process. Facilitate Purchasing Committee meetings and ensure that proper documentation is maintained. Supplier Contract and Relationship Management Accurately complete the master data management form (or contract/supplier register) Monitor and complete contract close-out, renewal or retender, as appropriate for the assigned commodities. Ensure that contractual conditions and performance indicators are understood by the suppliers. Identify & resolve or escalate contract-related issues both internally and externally. Analyze supplier performance based on customer feedback information & other sources and coordinate with supplier for improvement. Procurement Execution Receive incoming Purchase Requisitions (Pending Buyer Action), verify specifications are clear, conduct sourcing event if required items are not already on contract, update the PR with actual supplier record and release PR for approval. Follow Procurement Polices and guidelines in Supplier Award decisions under the applicable threshold. Manage PO Change requests coordinating with Requesters, Budget Owners and Suppliers Consolidates all required documentation for presentation to Finance for timely supplier payment for materials and services delivered Data Management, Analysis and Reporting Collect and analyze organization-wide data to support decision-making Provide support in the design of the business metrics to monitor SCM performance and alert management when the performance trigger is violated Conduct spend analysis to support strategic sourcing activities, and Supplier Relationship Management Prepare summary report of supplier bid responses for Procurement Committee award decision meetings Track and analyze procurement performance and savings against established target levels Process, Procedure and Policy Conduct all procurement-related tasks as per the approved procurement policies, processes and guidelines. Advice management regarding any challenge / risks / impractical guidelines. Collect customer feedback relating to the policies, processes and guidelines, and report to NO Management for improvements or changes. Review with Partners / Sub-Grantees, their SCM Policies, procedures and etc. to identify any gaps, document them under assessment reports, and capture under capacity building plans Systems Development and Implementation Collect and collate useful data which can be used to improve the general systems established and communicate this information to immediate Supervisor Control and Compliance Conduct supplier pre-qualification for all new suppliers and maintain records. Participate in development of risk identification & assessment tools, registers and other tools and assessing SCM and contractual risks for procurement of goods, works or services. Maintain proper filing and record keeping as per the guidelines set by the management. Coordinate with Requesters to close out open POs in a timely manner. Implementation of agreed audit recommendations in the procurement process as per the guidance given by the HoD. Participate in process to Review Partners / Sub-Grantees, internal control system in the procurement process to identify any gaps, document them under assessment reports, and capture under capacity building plans. Periodically monitor the progress on implementation of recommendations and update the management of all parties Leadership and Coaching Manage the performance of direct reports through performance reviews, frequent conversations and other methods as appropriate. Be courageous in providing coaching or feedback for continuous performance improvement Ensure that all Supply Chain staff members understand Procurement Policies, Processes, and Systems Plan and coordinate departmental meetings to review status of tasks and update Senior Management Team on the progress of the departments’ functions. Training and Capacity Building Coordinate, participate in, and/or train staff from Supply Chain Staff and other WVI Departments on WVI Procurement Policies, Processes, and Systems Conduct Partners' / Sub-Grantees' capacity assessment and capacity building plans as per set framework / guidelines. Train the Partners / Sub-Grantees based on the approved capacity building plan, monitor progress. Coordinate with internal stakeholders in monitoring the progress and submit progress reports to the management End Results: Adherence to business requirements in fulfilling procurement needs Customer purchasing requirements are fulfilled through pro-active planning of sourcing steps. Strategic Sourcing steps are properly followed for all assigned categories Contracts and supplier relationships are managed for all assigned categories Day to day procurement operations is managed smoothly, in compliance to policies and procedures Availability of information for supervisors to take decisions Adherence to Process, Procedure and Policy in fulfilling procurement needs Procurement operational requirements are met in system developments, modifications and implementation Procurement related Risks are identified, recorded and mitigation measures are taken Direct reports are clear on deliverables, well monitored and taken corrective measure Direct reports and partners are clear on WV Policies, processes and other procurement related guidelines Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Strategic Sourcing Category Management Procurement Risk Management Capacity Building Compensation & Other Benefits Provident fund,Mobile bill,Insurance,Gratuity,Weekly 2 holidays,Medical allowance Festival Bonus: 1 Employment Status Full Time Job Location Coxs Bazar

Requirements Education Post-graduate degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Responsibilities & Context Reports to: Project Manager, Sustho Sagor Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh (with field visits as required) Duration: 600 days (between November 2026 and October 2029) Liaison: Maintain regular work relationships with the Marine Conservation Program, and liaison with the Blue Action Fund Project Manager, Educational Outreach Program Coordinator, Procurement and Logistic Officer, Senior Finance Officer, and Human Resources (HR) Manager of WCS to ensure effective coordination and implementation of assigned activities. Background Wildlife Conservation Society Bangladesh Program is implementing the project, titled Sustho Sagor (Healthy Ocean) - Sharing responsibilities and benefits from well managed MPAs for a healthy ocean and thriving communities in Bangladesh, funded by the Blue Action Fund. The project aims to strengthen the network of ecologically representative MPAs and OECMs, improve MPA governance, and support sustainable livelihoods for coastal communities through capacity building, stakeholder engagement, field surveys, and public outreach. Effective delivery of these activities depends on timely, well-organized logistics across project sites, many of which are in remote coastal areas where WCS does not have a permanent presence. To support effective implementation of the project’s training, survey, outreach, and field activities and the associated financial, asset, and human resources requirements, WCS Bangladesh intends to engage a suitably qualified Logistics Management Consultant. Objectives: The objective of this consultancy is to ensure efficient, timely, and compliant logistical support for trainings, workshops, field surveys, outreach events, and other activities under the Sustho Sagor project, and to support program staff in fulfilling related financial, asset management, and human resources requirements. The consultant will achieve this by managing event and field logistics, processing purchase requisitions and field expense settlements, supporting procurement, documenting assets taken to and returned from the field, and providing human resources and administrative support, including onboarding, agreement preparation, and payment processing. Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Freight forwarding Additional Requirements Age At least 22 years Only candidates with relevant experience in the freight forwarding industry are encouraged to apply. Responsibilities & Context Coordinate day-to-day business development activities and follow up on leads. Assist the Business Development Team in preparing proposals, presentations, quotations, and reports. Maintain and update client databases and track sales activities and opportunities. Maintain and monitor the business development pipeline, including leads, prospects, and follow-ups. Support market research initiatives to identify new business opportunities and target markets. Liaise with internal teams to ensure timely delivery of client requirements. Coordinate with clients, agents, partners, and other business contacts as required. Stay informed on market trends and industry developments, providing relevant insights to management. Prepare regular reports and updates on business development activities and opportunities. Coordinate schedules, arrange meetings, and support business development engagements as required. Support client onboarding and coordinate with relevant departments following business confirmation. Handle administrative and coordination tasks related to business development functions. Skills & Expertise Business Development Communication Creative and innovative CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite. Exceptional attention to detail and analytical skills. Follow up and maintain deadline Freight forwarding knowledge Lead Generation Sales Reporting Time Management and Prioritization Compensation & Other Benefits Provident fund,Mobile bill,Insurance,Gratuity Salary Review: Yearly Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Banani)

Responsibilities & Context Planet Freight Services Ltd. a concern of Topstar Group, established in 1997, has grown into a leading freight forwarding company by consistently delivering high-quality logistics services. The company continuously invests in employee training, modern technology, and updated business practices to meet the evolving demands of global trade. With an experienced workforce and advanced infrastructure, it provides reliable, efficient, and customer-focused omni-channel logistics solutions. Key Responsibilities Communicating with customers through various channels regarding air export shipments. Keep constant contact with assigned overseas agents, airlines, and shippers for smooth handling of the shipments. Follow up SOP for every customer and ensure timely execution of all air export shipments. Booking follow-up, contacting shipper / buying house for booking with all proper shipment information and providing the required documents to the shipper. Responding promptly to customer inquiries regarding flight schedules, rates, booking status, and shipment documentation. Reporting EDI/DSR on time and maintaining accurate shipment updates. Ensure customer satisfaction and provide professional customer support throughout the shipment process. Ensure follow-up with the vendor, airline, and relevant parties for customs status, shipping documents, and cargo readiness. Providing clearance to the Air Operation team for planning, mentioning booking no., agent detail, preferred airline, selling rate, flight details, and estimated arrival time through mail only. Coordinate with the Air Operation team regarding cargo handover, flight confirmation, documentation, and urgent consignments. Follow up on AWB, HAWB/MAWB and other required air export documentation to ensure timely shipment processing. Sometimes communicate over the phone for urgent consignments and shipment-related matters. Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining a professional attitude. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Airport Operation Export & Import Export Documentation Export/ Import through L/C

(DU, JU, JNU, CU, RU, KU, NSU, IUB, AIUB, BRAC). MBA/EMBA from a reputed university will be preferred. Responsibilities & Context Planet Freight Services Ltd. a concern of Topstar Group, established in 1997, has grown into a leading freight forwarding company by consistently delivering high-quality logistics services. With an experienced workforce and advanced infrastructure, it provides reliable, efficient, and customer-focused omni-channel logistics solutions. Key Responsibilities Communicating with customers through various channels regarding air export shipments. Keep constant contact with assigned overseas agents, airlines, and shippers for smooth handling of the shipments. Follow up SOP for every customer and ensure timely execution of all air export shipments. Booking follow-up, contacting shipper / buying house for booking with all proper shipment information and providing the required documents to the shipper. Responding promptly to customer inquiries regarding flight schedules, rates, booking status, and shipment documentation. Reporting EDI/DSR on time and maintaining accurate shipment updates. Ensure customer satisfaction and provide professional customer support throughout the shipment process. Ensure follow-up with the vendor, airline, and relevant parties for customs status, shipping documents, and cargo readiness. Providing clearance to the Air Operation team for planning, mentioning booking no., agent detail, preferred airline, selling rate, flight details, and estimated arrival time through mail only. Coordinate with the Air Operation team regarding cargo handover, flight confirmation, documentation, and urgent consignments. Follow up on AWB, HAWB/MAWB and other required air export documentation to ensure timely shipment processing. Sometimes communicate over the phone for urgent consignments and shipment-related matters. Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining a professional attitude. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540885&fc.source_content:
Requirements Additional Requirements স্পষ্টভাবে কথা বলা, মনোযোগ দিয়ে শোনা এবং গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরির দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে। Sales, Customer Service বা Account Management-এ অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। ই-কমার্স, B2B সেলস বা চীন থেকে পণ্য সোর্সিং সম্পর্কে ধারণা থাকলে বাড়তি সুবিধা। WhatsApp Business, Excel/Google Sheets এবং কম্পিউটার ব্যবহারে দক্ষ হতে হবে। বাংলা ও বাংলিশে গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে লিখিত যোগাযোগ করতে পারতে হবে। দায়িত্বশীল, ধৈর্যশীল এবং নিয়মিত ফলোআপ ও লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অনুযায়ী কাজ করার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ বুঝে সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয়ের মাধ্যমে সমাধান করতে আগ্রহী হতে হবে। অভিজ্ঞ প্রার্থীদের পাশাপাশি প্রয়োজনীয় দক্ষতাসম্পন্ন নতুনরাও আবেদন করতে পারবেন। Responsibilities & Context Wholesale Plus গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে দীর্ঘমেয়াদি ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরি, নিয়মিত ফলোআপ এবং রিপিট অর্ডার বাড়ানোর জন্য ৫ জন Key Account Manager (KAM) নিয়োগ দেবে। প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ: নির্ধারিত গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে ফোন ও WhatsApp-এ নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা। গ্রাহকের ব্যবসা ও পণ্যের চাহিদা বুঝে সোর্সিং, কোটেশন ও অর্ডার করতে সহায়তা করা। পুরোনো ও নিষ্ক্রিয় গ্রাহকদের পুনরায় অর্ডারে আগ্রহী করা। সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহকদের অনুসন্ধান ফলোআপ করে অর্ডারে রূপান্তর করা। অর্ডার, পেমেন্ট ও ডেলিভারির আপডেট দেওয়া এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ ও সমস্যা সমাধানের অগ্রগতি অনুসরণ করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ব্যবসায়িক ও কর্পোরেট গ্রাহকদের ভিজিট করা। গ্রাহকের তথ্য, যোগাযোগের বিবরণ ও পরবর্তী ফলোআপের তারিখ নির্ধারিত সিস্টেমে সংরক্ষণ করা। মাসিক বিক্রয় ও রিপিট অর্ডারের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জনে কাজ করা। দৈনিক কাজ ও সাপ্তাহিক অগ্রগতির রিপোর্ট দেওয়া এবং গ্রাহকের মতামত জানানো। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Relationship Management/ Key Account Management Customer Relationship B2B and B2C sales and marketing Lead Generation Complaint Handling skill Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Additional Requirements স্পষ্টভাবে কথা বলা, মনোযোগ দিয়ে শোনা এবং গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরির দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে। Sales, Customer Service বা Account Management-এ অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। ই-কমার্স, B2B সেলস বা চীন থেকে পণ্য সোর্সিং সম্পর্কে ধারণা থাকলে বাড়তি সুবিধা। WhatsApp Business, Excel/Google Sheets এবং কম্পিউটার ব্যবহারে দক্ষ হতে হবে। বাংলা ও বাংলিশে গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে লিখিত যোগাযোগ করতে পারতে হবে। দায়িত্বশীল, ধৈর্যশীল এবং নিয়মিত ফলোআপ ও লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অনুযায়ী কাজ করার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ বুঝে সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয়ের মাধ্যমে সমাধান করতে আগ্রহী হতে হবে। অভিজ্ঞ প্রার্থীদের পাশাপাশি প্রয়োজনীয় দক্ষতাসম্পন্ন নতুনরাও আবেদন করতে পারবেন। Responsibilities & Context Wholesale Plus গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে দীর্ঘমেয়াদি ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরি, নিয়মিত ফলোআপ এবং রিপিট অর্ডার বাড়ানোর জন্য ৫ জন Key Account Manager (KAM) নিয়োগ দেবে। প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ: নির্ধারিত গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে ফোন ও WhatsApp-এ নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা। গ্রাহকের ব্যবসা ও পণ্যের চাহিদা বুঝে সোর্সিং, কোটেশন ও অর্ডার করতে সহায়তা করা। পুরোনো ও নিষ্ক্রিয় গ্রাহকদের পুনরায় অর্ডারে আগ্রহী করা। সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহকদের অনুসন্ধান ফলোআপ করে অর্ডারে রূপান্তর করা। অর্ডার, পেমেন্ট ও ডেলিভারির আপডেট দেওয়া এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ ও সমস্যা সমাধানের অগ্রগতি অনুসরণ করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ব্যবসায়িক ও কর্পোরেট গ্রাহকদের ভিজিট করা। গ্রাহকের তথ্য, যোগাযোগের বিবরণ ও পরবর্তী ফলোআপের তারিখ নির্ধারিত সিস্টেমে সংরক্ষণ করা। মাসিক বিক্রয় ও রিপিট অর্ডারের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জনে কাজ করা। দৈনিক কাজ ও সাপ্তাহিক অগ্রগতির রিপোর্ট দেওয়া এবং গ্রাহকের মতামত জানানো। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Relationship Management/ Key Account Management Customer Relationship B2B and B2C sales and marketing Lead Generation Complaint Handling skill Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540904&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Masters in commerce background from any reputed university. Additional Requirements Age At most 45 years Minimum 1 years experience in the NGO sector Experience in Hospital management is preferable; Excellent organizational and multi-tasking ability, strong communication, report writing, presentation, and negotiation skills; Proficient in English (oral and written); Age limit could be consider as per candidate experiance. Responsibilities & Context Job Context: Dhaka Ahsania Mission (DAM) is a non-government development organization founded in 1958 by Khan Bahadur Ahsanullah, an eminent educationist, reformer, and Sufi with the aim of social and spiritual development of the entire human community. DAM has been contributing for the betterment of the disadvantaged population through operating 35 institutions and also 8 sectors of development. The Health and Nutrition Sector is one of the core sectors of DAM which has also been operating 7 institutions and 9 projects. DAM Health and Nutrition Sector is going to recruit a competent and self-motivated individual for the position of Accounts and Admin Officer for "Mayer Hashi General Hospital and Diagnostic Center" at Ashulia, Dhaka. Job Responsibility: Oversee day-to-day administrative operations, including scheduling, inventory management, and facility coordination, to ensure efficient hospital functioning. Assist central HR in the overall recruitment and employee HR relevant relevant process. Coordinate effectively with various departments to facilitate smooth and uninterrupted hospital operations. Supervise and manage support staff, including clerical, front desk, housekeeping, and other administrative personnel. Assist in the development, implementation, and periodic review of hospital policies, procedures, and compliance standards. Maintain accurate, confidential, and up-to-date patient records, administrative documentation, and institutional files. Monitor administrative workflows and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and service quality. Manage patient billing, invoicing, account reconciliation, and related financial documentation. Oversee payroll processing and ensure timely and accurate payments to employees, suppliers, and service providers. Prepare and maintain financial reports, budgets, cash-flow projections, and periodic financial forecasts. Monitor hospital expenditures, control operational costs, and implement appropriate cost-saving measures. Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, financial institutions, and relevant regulatory authorities as required. Ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations, accounting standards, tax requirements, and internal hospital policies. Maintain proper financial records and supporting documentation for audit, reporting, and management review purposes. Provide management with timely financial and administrative information to support effective planning and decision-making. Perform any other tasks time to time given by the authority. As a member of the organization, uphold and comply with DAM’s Safeguarding Policies and Code of Conduct, and take appropriate action to prevent, report, and respond to safeguarding concerns in accordance with established procedures. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Operational Management Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Ashulia)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1539588&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or any relevant discipline. MBA/Masters degree in Marketing or Management will be an advantage. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Automobile Additional Requirements Age 25 to 35 years Only Male Typically 2–3 years of relevant experience in sales, preferably in the motorcycle, automobile, automotive parts, or related industry. Experience in dealer management, retail sales, territory management, and market development will be preferred. Responsibilities & Context The Territory Sales Manager (TSM) will be responsible for achieving motorcycle sales targets, developing and managing the dealer network, expanding market coverage, and increasing the companys market share within the assigned territory. The position requires extensive fieldwork, strong dealer relationships, market analysis, and effective execution of sales and promotional strategies. Key Responsibilities Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual motorcycle sales targets for the assigned territory. Manage, develop, and maintain strong relationships with authorized dealers and sub-dealers. Identify and appoint potential new dealers to expand market coverage. Monitor dealer-wise and model-wise sales performance and take corrective actions where required. Drive secondary/retail sales through dealers and ensure regular product availability. Conduct frequent market and dealer visits to monitor sales, stock, showroom activities, and customer demand. Develop new markets and identify opportunities for increasing motorcycle penetration. Monitor competitors pricing, products, offers, promotions, dealer activities, and market strategies. Implement company-approved sales campaigns, promotional activities, branding, and merchandising programs. Train and motivate dealer sales teams on product features, customer handling, and sales techniques. Monitor dealer inventory and coordinate with relevant teams to maintain optimum stock levels. Support dealers in resolving sales, service, documentation, and customer-related issues. Monitor customer feedback and ensure proper resolution of complaints in coordination with the service team. Follow up on motorcycle registration/documentation processes where applicable. Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales, stock, market, and competitor reports. Analyze territory sales data and prepare sales forecasts and action plans. Ensure compliance with company pricing, branding, sales, and operational policies. Monitor dealer showroom standards, product display, signage, and promotional materials. Maintain strong relationships with dealers, customers, and other relevant market stakeholders. Perform any other sales-related responsibilities assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Sales Sales & Marketing Other Relevant Skills Territory sales Sales Target Achievement Market Development Market Analysis Sales Forecasting Compensation & Other Benefits Tour allowance,Mobile bill,Performance bonus Salary Review: Yearly Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize Festival Bonus: 2 Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Prepare reports and provide regular updates to higher management on project and administrative status. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540795&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education HSC Bachelor/Honors Diploma Experience 1 to 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): E-commerce, Educational Technology (Edtech) Startup, Telecommunication Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 20 to 32 years Only Female This is a fully on-site position at Motijheel. Candidates must be able to commute to the office regularly and comfortably during the scheduled working hours. Those who may face commuting difficulties are requested not to apply. Experience Fresh graduates are eligible to apply. Candidates with prior experience in customer support or related fields will be given preference. Requirements Must be self-motivated with the ability to work independently under minimal supervision. Detail-oriented and well-organized. Proficient in Google Sheets for data entry, tracking, and reporting. Excellent verbal communication skills—able to speak clearly, confidently, and professionally over the phone. Candidates who are not comfortable communicating effectively over the phone are requested not to apply. Candidates unwilling or unable to strictly follow the defined sales process are requested not to apply. Strong aptitude for sales and interpersonal communication. Patient, responsible, and team-oriented mindset. Responsibilities & Context Contact leads generated through Facebook advertisements, provide parents with detailed information about our product "Bigganbaksho," and convert leads into confirmed sales. Manage outbound calls via CRM and maintain accurate, organized CRM data entry and updates. Track sales performance and regularly update sales data in Google Sheets with precision. Consistently meet daily and weekly call targets. Strictly adhere to the designated sales process and maintain discipline at every stage. Demonstrate a proactive, results-driven attitude toward achieving monthly sales targets. Skills & Expertise Communication and interpersonal skill Computer Literacy Telesales Other Relevant Skills Telesales Outbound calls Google Sheets Sales Target Achievement Compensation & Other Benefits Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Festival Bonus: Twice a year. Complimentary Snacks & Tea. Office Mosque and Office Library. Free health check-ups and medical consultations through an in-house MBBS physician. Free physiotherapy services through an in-house consultant. Special discounts on medical tests at renowned hospitals. Career advancement opportunities within the organization. Medical leave, marriage leave, and government holidays. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only females are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Motijheel)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Plan, launch, and optimize Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns Manage targeting, budgets, creatives, keywords, conversions, and CPA. Strong skills in graphic design for both images and videos. Creative mindset and ability to handle multiple tasks. Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities The incumbent will be directly responsible for developing and managing Institutional Sales (Business-to-Business/B2B) for products manufactured and marketed by Quasem Industries PLC and its sister concerns. The role will focus on identifying and developing institutional customers, expanding the B2B customer base, generating sales opportunities, and achieving assigned sales targets. The product portfolio includes Sunlite Battery & Lighter, Sun Chips, Sun Drinking Water, Air Freshener, Pop’s, Pups, Body Spray, and other upcoming consumer products of the Group. The incumbent will establish and maintain strong relationships with corporate organizations, institutions, offices, factories, hotels, restaurants, educational institutions, hospitals, NGOs, government and non-government organizations, distributors, and other potential B2B customers. Identify new business opportunities across institutional and corporate sectors Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline for sustainable business growth Expand the customer base by acquiring new institutional accounts Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and commercial agreements Ensure compliance with organizational policies and customer requirements Develop and execute institutional sales strategies to achieve annual sales and profitability targets He will be fluent in both written and spoken English and Bengali. Candidates must be confident, assured and well-spoken. The employee must maintain good personal hygiene and have a smart appearance. Perform any other jobs as required by the management. Candidates with some experience working in corporate office environment will be given preference. Candidates who have motorcycle driving license will be given preference. raw_source_fields.education: Post Graduation from any reputed university with no Third Division/Class
raw_source_fields.vacancy: . A. Assistant Manager – Product Development & Campaign Management, Cards (SO-SEO) Develop and enhance credit card products and propositions based on customer needs, market trends and business objectives. Manage end-to-end product lifecycle, including developing business cases, coordinating product launches, executing upgrades and conducting periodic performance reviews. Plan, launch, and monitor card campaigns by managing data-driven customer segmentation, defining rewarding propositions and analyzing return on investment (ROI). Track and analyze the performance of existing products, active campaigns and competitor offerings to deliver actionable insights for portfolio optimization. Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, IT, Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure the seamless rollout of products and campaigns. B. Assistant Manager – MIS (Cards) (SO-SEO) manage large-scale Card Business data to guarantee absolute accuracy, completeness, and timely availability for business reporting. Design and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports, executive dashboards, and KPIs tracking overall card business activities. Conduct rigorous variance analysis, portfolio health checks and product profitability assessments to identify revenue opportunities and operational bottlenecks. Monitor data integrity, reconcile information and maintain appropriate documentation and reporting controls. Support reporting automation, dashboard enhancement and timely delivery of management information to relevant stakeholders. C. Assistant Manager/Team Leader – Sales Governance (Officer-EO) Monitor Card Sales activities and processes to ensure compliance with approved policies, KYC, documentation and sales-governance requirements. Identify and monitor mis-selling, process deviations, exceptions, documentation gaps and other sales-control issues. Review sales MIS, campaign/product eligibility, incentive-related controls and governance trackers to identify irregularities and performance risks. Coordinate corrective and preventive actions with Sales, Operations, Compliance, Risk and other relevant functions and support audit requirements. Analyze customer complaints, post-issuance verification trends, and responsible-sales performance indicators to build comprehensive governance dashboards for senior leadership. Skills & Expertise Credit Control And Recovery Direct Sales MIS Monitoring Monitoring and Reporting Payroll and Banking Product Development Retail Banking Sales Specialized Leasing Operational (Monitoring/ collection)

To facilitate prompt processing and support, candidates are required to submit their applications through The Premier Bank PLC Career Portal (https://recruitment.thepremierbankplc.com/)
Strong analytical and quantitative capability with Product Development, MIS, Team Leader and etc.
Sound knowledge of modern Retail Business & practices strategic frameworks
Proficiency in MS Office and Retail information systems.
Age not exceeding 40 years as of 01 October, 2026.
Responsibilities & Context
The Premier Bank PLC., one of Bangladesh’s leading private commercial banks, is looking for dynamic, customer-focused and experienced professionals to join its Retail Banking Division in the following positions.
A. Assistant Manager – Product Development & Campaign Management, Cards (SO-SEO)
Develop and enhance credit card products and propositions based on customer needs, market trends and business objectives.
Manage end-to-end product lifecycle, including developing business cases, coordinating product launches, executing upgrades and conducting periodic performance reviews.
Plan, launch, and monitor card campaigns by managing data-driven customer segmentation, defining rewarding propositions and analyzing return on investment (ROI).
Track and analyze the performance of existing products, active campaigns and competitor offerings to deliver actionable insights for portfolio optimization.
Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, IT, Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure the seamless rollout of products and campaigns.
B. Assistant Manager – MIS (Cards) (SO-SEO)
manage large-scale Card Business data to guarantee absolute accuracy, completeness, and timely availability for business reporting.
Design and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports, executive dashboards, and KPIs tracking overall card business activities.
Conduct rigorous variance analysis, portfolio health checks and product profitability assessments to identify revenue opportunities and operational bottlenecks.
Monitor data integrity, reconcile information and maintain appropriate documentation and reporting controls.
Support reporting automation, dashboard enhancement and timely delivery of management information to relevant stakeholders.
C. Assistant Manager/Team Leader – Sales Governance (Officer-EO)
Monitor Card Sales activities and processes to ensure compliance with approved policies, KYC, documentation and sales-governance requirements.
Identify and monitor mis-selling, process deviations, exceptions, documentation gaps and other sales-control issues.
Review sales MIS, campaign/product eligibility, incentive-related controls and governance trackers to identify irregularities and performance risks.
Coordinate corrective and preventive actions with Sales, Operations, Compliance, Risk and other relevant functions and support audit requirements.
Analyze customer complaints, post-issuance verification trends, and responsible-sales performance indicators to build comprehensive governance dashboards for senior leadership.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Attractive compensation package including Group Insurance coverage
A professional and friendly working environment;
Clear career progression opportunities.

Requirements Education Masters in commerce background from any reputed university. Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Age At most 45 years Minimum 1 years experience in the NGO sector Experience in Hospital management is preferable; Excellent organizational and multi-tasking ability, strong communication, report writing, presentation, and negotiation skills; Proficient in English (oral and written); Age limit could be consider as per candidate experiance. Responsibilities & Context Job Context: Dhaka Ahsania Mission (DAM) is a non-government development organization founded in 1958 by Khan Bahadur Ahsanullah, an eminent educationist, reformer, and Sufi with the aim of social and spiritual development of the entire human community. DAM has been contributing for the betterment of the disadvantaged population through operating 35 institutions and also 8 sectors of development. The Health and Nutrition Sector is one of the core sectors of DAM which has also been operating 7 institutions and 9 projects. DAM Health and Nutrition Sector is going to recruit a competent and self-motivated individual for the position of Accounts and Admin Officer for "Mayer Hashi General Hospital and Diagnostic Center" at Ashulia, Dhaka. Job Responsibility: Oversee day-to-day administrative operations, including scheduling, inventory management, and facility coordination, to ensure efficient hospital functioning. Assist central HR in the overall recruitment and employee HR relevant relevant process. Coordinate effectively with various departments to facilitate smooth and uninterrupted hospital operations. Supervise and manage support staff, including clerical, front desk, housekeeping, and other administrative personnel. Assist in the development, implementation, and periodic review of hospital policies, procedures, and compliance standards. Maintain accurate, confidential, and up-to-date patient records, administrative documentation, and institutional files. Monitor administrative workflows and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and service quality. Manage patient billing, invoicing, account reconciliation, and related financial documentation. Oversee payroll processing and ensure timely and accurate payments to employees, suppliers, and service providers. Prepare and maintain financial reports, budgets, cash-flow projections, and periodic financial forecasts. Monitor hospital expenditures, control operational costs, and implement appropriate cost-saving measures. Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, financial institutions, and relevant regulatory authorities as required. Ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations, accounting standards, tax requirements, and internal hospital policies. Maintain proper financial records and supporting documentation for audit, reporting, and management review purposes. Provide management with timely financial and administrative information to support effective planning and decision-making. Perform any other tasks time to time given by the authority. As a member of the organization, uphold and comply with DAM’s Safeguarding Policies and Code of Conduct, and take appropriate action to prevent, report, and respond to safeguarding concerns in accordance with established procedures. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounts and audit Administrative Support Financial Management Payroll Administration Staff Supervision Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Ashulia)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540951&fc.title: Executive - Internal Audit

raw_source_fields.experience: will be an advantage; however, fresh graduates with strong academic credentials from any public university are encouraged to apply. Effective communication and interpersonal skill Critical thinking and analysis The ability to write clear, concise, and grammatically correct English reports is crucial. Problem solving abilities Proficiency in IIA Standards, risks and controls frameworks (COSO etc.) Highest level of integrity Maintains objectivity in appearance and fact Ability to quickly learn new areas of business Flexibility to travel and visit various locations of the organizations partners, including call centers, distribution houses, among others. Responsibilities & Context Support the development of risk-based audit plans and roadmaps aligned with organizational goals, and assist in maintaining the audit universe, risk register, and other relevant tools to continuously assess, link, and prioritize critical business risks. Perform internal audit activities in accordance with IIA Standards, IIA Code of Ethics, Code of Conduct, organizational policies and procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements, while staying updated on audit methodologies, industry best practices, trends, and emerging issues that may impact the business. Demonstrate adherence to established policies and procedures and apply a systematic, disciplined, and value-adding approach to internal audit activities that meets the needs of the organization. Develop and document engagement plans, including objectives, scope, timelines, and resource requirements, considering the organization’s strategies, objectives, and risks relevant to each engagement. Independently perform and document assigned audit engagements by identifying, analyzing, evaluating, and documenting sufficient and appropriate information to achieve engagement objectives within approved timelines, budgets, and departmental standards. Develop, maintain, and update control assessment frameworks, models, criteria, and Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs) at the engagement level to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls, processes, and systems. Maintain professional objectivity and independence throughout audit engagements; disclose any actual or perceived impairment of independence or objectivity, ensure balanced assessments based on relevant facts, and avoid undue influence from personal interests or other parties. Consider the possibility of significant errors, fraud, and non-compliance during assigned engagements and conduct appropriate examinations and verifications in line with professional standards and the level of diligence expected from a competent internal auditor. Ensure audit quality and timely delivery by assessing whether engagements adequately cover the approved scope and key risks, objectively evaluate governance, risk management, and controls, identify current business issues and their strategic or operational implications, and provide appropriate recommendations. Communicate audit results in an accurate, objective, clear, concise, constructive, complete, and timely manner, and work with auditees, process owners, and management to develop appropriate action plans and resolve identified control issues and risks. Conduct periodic follow-ups on audit recommendations and action plans, ensure timely implementation of agreed actions, and maintain the audit follow-up tracking system as required by the department. Escalate to the Head of Internal Audit (HIA), through the appropriate channel, where management or divisional heads accept a level of risk that may be unacceptable to the organization. Maintain a thorough and current understanding of the organization’s objectives, strategies, processes, systems, capabilities, employees, culture, industry practices, and business environment to ensure relevant and effective audit assessments. Consider the work of other assurance providers and assess whether reliance on their work is appropriate based on their scope and procedures, while coordinating with other control and monitoring functions to ensure effective use of audit resources. Build and maintain effective working relationships with process owners and business management to support improvements in internal controls, risk management, business processes, effectiveness, and efficiency. Assist the supervisor in functional, administrative, and other audit-related matters as and when required. Skills & Expertise Audit reporting Compliance Compliance and Integrity Critical and analytical thinking Data analysis Internal Control Problem solving and decision making Risk Assessment Target Oriented Other Relevant Skills Compliance code of conduct Internal Audit Risk Analysis

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Masters Masters or Bachelors degree in any discipline from a reputed university with no third division/class or equivalent in academic result. Professional qualifications such as CA, CMA, ACCA, CFA, MPA, MPF, MPB, MBM will be given preference. Necessary maintenance / cash loading / reconcile of ATM. Job Context:
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Jr. Executive, Business Development to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in bridging connections between pharmaceutical clients and international suppliers. Your primary focus will be supporting raw material sourcing (APIs and Excipients), coordinating regulatory and technical documentation, and maintaining effective communication to drive business growth in the pharmaceutical sector.
Job Responsibilities
Client Communication & Requirement Gathering: Regularly communicate with pharmaceutical companies to identify and understand their new requirements for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Excipients.
Supplier & Source Development: Identify, evaluate, and develop potential foreign suppliers, factories, and principals for high-quality pharmaceutical raw materials.
Technical & Regulatory Documentation: Assist pharma clients by promptly providing essential technical documents, including Certificates of Analysis (COA), Methods of Analysis (MOA), Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), and Stability Reports etc.
Commercial Coordination: Request, collect, and analyze price quotations from international factories, suppliers, and principals to ensure competitive sourcing.
Sample Procurement: Coordinate with foreign partners to collect and deliver required product samples to clients for testing and evaluation.

Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Human Resource Management Experience 1 to 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Garments, Group of Companies Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Responsibilities & Context 1. Coordinate training schedules, participants, venues and logistical arrangements across different SBUs. 2. Assist in planning, organizing and executing training sessions, workshops and other learning activities. 3. Prepare and maintain training documentation, including attendance sheets, feedback forms, certificates and training reports. 4. Support the Training Manager in developing PowerPoint presentations, training materials and other learning resources. 5. Support the implementation of training programs, employee engagement activities and other Learning & Development initiatives. 8. Coordinate with relevant departments and stakeholders to ensure the timely execution of training plans and fulfilment of learning requirements. Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Business-to-Business (B2B) Software and Services Startup, IT Enabled Service, Software Company Additional Requirements Age At least 23 years Only Male Responsibilities & Context Cognova IT is looking for a result-oriented Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist who will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns to generate qualified leads and support business growth. The ideal candidate should have practical experience in Meta/Facebook & Instagram Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn marketing, social media management, lead generation, campaign analytics, audience targeting, remarketing, and sales funnel optimization . The person will work closely with the Sales and Management teams to promote Cognova IT’s software products and IT services, generate potential B2B customers, improve online visibility, and convert digital traffic into meaningful business opportunities. The role is particularly focused on promoting products and services such as School & College ERP, Business ERP, POS Software, Custom Software Development, Mobile Applications, Website Development, Business Automation, Digital Marketing Services, and other IT solutions . Job Responsibilities Plan and execute digital marketing strategies aligned with the company’s sales and business development goals. Create, manage, monitor, and optimize Facebook, Instagram and Meta advertising campaigns . Plan and manage Google Ads , including Search, Display, and remarketing campaigns where applicable. Generate qualified B2B leads for the company’s software products and IT services. Conduct target audience research based on industry, business category, location, company size, job title, interests, and customer behavior. Develop targeted campaigns for schools, colleges, diagnostic centers, hospitals, real estate companies, construction companies, retail businesses, corporate organizations, and other potential customers. Manage and grow the company’s presence on Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant digital platforms . Create campaign plans, promotional concepts, post ideas, ad copies, headlines, calls-to-action, and lead-generation content. Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, developers, and content creators for marketing materials. Develop and optimize lead generation campaigns, landing pages, enquiry forms, and conversion funnels . Monitor leads generated from Facebook, Google, LinkedIn, website forms, WhatsApp, Messenger, phone calls, and other digital sources. Maintain proper lead data and coordinate with the Sales team for timely follow-up. Track the complete lead journey from campaign source to enquiry, meeting, demo, proposal, and conversion. Develop sales funnels for different products and target customer segments. Set up and optimize remarketing/retargeting campaigns for website visitors and previous prospects. Improve campaign performance through continuous testing of audience, creative, copy, placement, bidding strategy, and landing pages. Perform A/B testing on advertisements, creatives, headlines, offers, and landing pages. Monitor important performance metrics such as CPL, CPC, CTR, CPM, conversion rate, ROAS, lead quality, and customer acquisition cost . Prepare weekly and monthly digital marketing and lead-generation performance reports. Analyze campaign data and recommend actions to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs. Conduct competitor analysis and identify new digital marketing opportunities. Research market trends, customer behavior, competitor campaigns, and emerging digital channels. Support SEO and website traffic growth initiatives in coordination with the website/content team. Assist in developing marketing content including social media posts, promotional campaigns, product presentations, case studies, client success stories, and marketing materials. Promote customer testimonials, completed projects, product demonstrations, and company achievements through digital channels. Develop campaigns for product launches, promotional offers, events, seminars, demonstrations, and business meetings. Use LinkedIn to identify relevant companies, decision-makers, business owners, IT managers, school administrators, and other prospective clients. Support email, WhatsApp, Messenger, and other digital communication campaigns for lead nurturing. Maintain databases of potential customers generated through online campaigns and research. Work closely with the Sales team to understand lead quality and continuously improve targeting strategies. Help management determine the most effective marketing channels and advertising budgets based on measurable results. Ensure proper use of Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other analytics tools where required. Monitor the company website and digital channels to identify opportunities for improving conversion rates. Maintain consistency of Cognova IT’s brand identity and communication across digital platforms. Stay updated with changes in Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn, SEO, AI-based marketing tools, and digital marketing trends. Use relevant AI tools for content ideation, campaign research, marketing automation, analysis, and productivity . Perform any other digital marketing, lead-generation, or business-growth activities assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Google Ads B2B Marketing Lead Generation Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Business-to-Business (B2B) Software and Services Startup, IT Enabled Service, Software Company Additional Requirements Age At least 23 years Only Male Responsibilities & Context Cognova IT is looking for a result-oriented Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist who will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns to generate qualified leads and support business growth. The ideal candidate should have practical experience in Meta/Facebook & Instagram Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn marketing, social media management, lead generation, campaign analytics, audience targeting, remarketing, and sales funnel optimization . The person will work closely with the Sales and Management teams to promote Cognova IT’s software products and IT services, generate potential B2B customers, improve online visibility, and convert digital traffic into meaningful business opportunities. The role is particularly focused on promoting products and services such as School & College ERP, Business ERP, POS Software, Custom Software Development, Mobile Applications, Website Development, Business Automation, Digital Marketing Services, and other IT solutions . Job Responsibilities Plan and execute digital marketing strategies aligned with the company’s sales and business development goals. Create, manage, monitor, and optimize Facebook, Instagram and Meta advertising campaigns . Plan and manage Google Ads , including Search, Display, and remarketing campaigns where applicable. Generate qualified B2B leads for the company’s software products and IT services. Conduct target audience research based on industry, business category, location, company size, job title, interests, and customer behavior. Develop targeted campaigns for schools, colleges, diagnostic centers, hospitals, real estate companies, construction companies, retail businesses, corporate organizations, and other potential customers. Manage and grow the company’s presence on Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant digital platforms . Create campaign plans, promotional concepts, post ideas, ad copies, headlines, calls-to-action, and lead-generation content. Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, developers, and content creators for marketing materials. Develop and optimize lead generation campaigns, landing pages, enquiry forms, and conversion funnels . Monitor leads generated from Facebook, Google, LinkedIn, website forms, WhatsApp, Messenger, phone calls, and other digital sources. Maintain proper lead data and coordinate with the Sales team for timely follow-up. Track the complete lead journey from campaign source to enquiry, meeting, demo, proposal, and conversion. Develop sales funnels for different products and target customer segments. Set up and optimize remarketing/retargeting campaigns for website visitors and previous prospects. Improve campaign performance through continuous testing of audience, creative, copy, placement, bidding strategy, and landing pages. Perform A/B testing on advertisements, creatives, headlines, offers, and landing pages. Monitor important performance metrics such as CPL, CPC, CTR, CPM, conversion rate, ROAS, lead quality, and customer acquisition cost . Prepare weekly and monthly digital marketing and lead-generation performance reports. Analyze campaign data and recommend actions to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs. Conduct competitor analysis and identify new digital marketing opportunities. Research market trends, customer behavior, competitor campaigns, and emerging digital channels. Support SEO and website traffic growth initiatives in coordination with the website/content team. Assist in developing marketing content including social media posts, promotional campaigns, product presentations, case studies, client success stories, and marketing materials. Promote customer testimonials, completed projects, product demonstrations, and company achievements through digital channels. Develop campaigns for product launches, promotional offers, events, seminars, demonstrations, and business meetings. Use LinkedIn to identify relevant companies, decision-makers, business owners, IT managers, school administrators, and other prospective clients. Support email, WhatsApp, Messenger, and other digital communication campaigns for lead nurturing. Maintain databases of potential customers generated through online campaigns and research. Work closely with the Sales team to understand lead quality and continuously improve targeting strategies. Help management determine the most effective marketing channels and advertising budgets based on measurable results. Ensure proper use of Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other analytics tools where required. Monitor the company website and digital channels to identify opportunities for improving conversion rates. Maintain consistency of Cognova IT’s brand identity and communication across digital platforms. Stay updated with changes in Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn, SEO, AI-based marketing tools, and digital marketing trends. Use relevant AI tools for content ideation, campaign research, marketing automation, analysis, and productivity . Perform any other digital marketing, lead-generation, or business-growth activities assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Google Ads B2B Marketing Lead Generation Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Additional Requirements 3–10 years of relevant experience in sales and business development within the textile chemical industry. Candidates with proven experience in selling textile dyes, auxiliaries, specialty chemicals or other textile processing chemicals will be preferred. Strong knowledge of textile chemicals, including pretreatment, dyeing, printing and finishing applications. Proven experience in selling textile chemicals to textile mills, dyeing, washing and finishing industries. Established relationships with textile manufacturers and key industry stakeholders will be an advantage. Strong business development, negotiation and customer relationship management skills. Good understanding of market dynamics, competitor activities, pricing and sales strategies within the textile chemical sector. Promote and sell textile chemical products by understanding customer requirements and recommending suitable products and solutions. Conduct regular customer visits, technical discussions and product presentations to identify business opportunities and strengthen customer engagement. Coordinate with international principals and suppliers to provide technical support, product information and customized solutions to customers. Arrange product trials, laboratory evaluations and industrial trials in collaboration with customers and technical teams to facilitate product approvals and business conversion Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve assigned sales targets, improve market penetration and ensure sustainable business growth. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing strategies and emerging technologies in the textile chemical industry. Manage customer accounts, negotiate commercial terms, prepare quotations and follow up on sales orders and payments. Maintain up-to-date CRM reports, highlighting potential opportunities and pipeline developments. Requirements Education Bachelors / Masters degree in Accounting/Finance from a recognized University. Having a 3rd class/division in any examination will incur ineligibility Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Age At most 45 years Experience: Minimum 3 years of proven experience in financial management, accounting, and reporting, preferably in a development organization in Bangladesh Responsibilities & Context Bangladesh is recognized as one of the country’s most vulnerable to the impacts of climate change. The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) has identified the coastal region as one of the major climate hotspot areas due to increasing salinity intrusion, sea-level rise, cyclones, storm surges, tidal flooding, and coastal erosion. These climate-induced hazards have significantly affected the livelihoods, health, and living conditions of coastal communities. Among the most critical challenges is the scarcity of safe drinking water, as freshwater sources are increasingly becoming saline and unsuitable for human consumption. The experience of Nowabenki Gonomukhi Foundation (NGF) indicates that climate-vulnerable coastal communities continue to face severe difficulties in accessing safe and reliable drinking water. Salinity intrusion into both surface and groundwater sources, coupled with the impacts of recurrent cyclones and tidal surges, has substantially reduced the availability of potable water. As a result, people—particularly women and children—are compelled to travel long distances to collect drinking water, exposing them to health risks, economic hardship, and reduced productivity. Limited access to safe drinking water also contributes to waterborne diseases and undermines the resilience of vulnerable households. Under these circumstances, to improve access to safe drinking water and strengthen the climate resilience of vulnerable coastal communities in the selected upazilas of Khulna, Bagerhat, and Satkhira districts, Nowabenki Gonomukhi Foundation (NGF) will implement the project titled “Access to Safe Drinking Water for the Climate Vulnerable People in Coastal Areas of Bangladesh through Solar-generated Reverse Osmosis Water Treatment Facilities.” The project will be financed by the Adaptation Fund (AF) through Palli Karma-Sahayak Foundation (PKSF) and will be implemented over a period of two years. The specific objectives of the project are: Ensure access to safe and climate-resilient drinking water for vulnerable coastal communities through the installation and operation of Reverse Osmosis (RO) water treatment plants. Enhance awareness and knowledge of climate-vulnerable communities on safe drinking water, health, hygiene, and climate change adaptation practices. Reports to: Focal Person of Organizations Duration: One year (Renewable based on performance and project timeline). Responsibilities & Context
Bangladesh is recognized as one of the country’s most vulnerable to the impacts of climate change. The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) has identified the coastal region as one of the major climate hotspot areas due to increasing salinity intrusion, sea-level rise, cyclones, storm surges, tidal flooding, and coastal erosion. These climate-induced hazards have significantly affected the livelihoods, health, and living conditions of coastal communities. Among the most critical challenges is the scarcity of safe drinking water, as freshwater sources are increasingly becoming saline and unsuitable for human consumption.
The experience of Nowabenki Gonomukhi Foundation (NGF) indicates that climate-vulnerable coastal communities continue to face severe difficulties in accessing safe and reliable drinking water. Salinity intrusion into both surface and groundwater sources, coupled with the impacts of recurrent cyclones and tidal surges, has substantially reduced the availability of potable water. As a result, people—particularly women and children—are compelled to travel long distances to collect drinking water, exposing them to health risks, economic hardship, and reduced productivity. Limited access to safe drinking water also contributes to waterborne diseases and undermines the resilience of vulnerable households.

Candidates with Electrical Licensing Board (ELB) Supervisor/Electrician certification will be given preference. Good understanding of electrical power systems and basic electrical engineering principles. Basic knowledge of electrical drawings, SLD, load calculation, control panels, and power equipment. Good communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Good command of Bangla and English, both written and spoken. Proficiency in MS Office will be an advantage. Must be willing to travel and work at project sites across Bangladesh. Proactive, responsible, and willing to learn. Candidates interested in both technical engineering and sales activities are encouraged to apply. People with no experience in Sells & Marketing are discouraged to apply. Responsibilities & Context MH DHANMONDI LTD. is looking for a motivated and technically capable Generator Sells & Business Development (Assistant Engineer Electric) to join our team in Bangladesh. The position is suitable for fresh Diploma/BSc Electrical Engineers as well as candidates with 2–3 years of relevant experience in power generation, substation, technical sales, or commissioning. Job Responsibilities Support technical sales and business development activities for power and electrical solutions. Visit clients, consultants, contractors, industries, and project sites to understand technical requirements. Conduct site surveys, load assessments, and technical inspections for power projects. Assist in sales, installation, testing, commissioning, and after-sales support of: Substations and Power Distribution Systems Diesel/Gas Generator Sets Solar Power Systems and related equipment Synchronization, ATS/AMF, control and protection systems ACB, MCCB, switchgear, electrical panels and related equipment Prepare and review technical quotations, BOQ, SLD, specifications, tender documents, and proposals . Assist in system design, equipment selection, load calculations, and technical solutions according to project requirements. Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and internal technical teams. Support installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance activities at project sites. Follow up on quotations, tenders, ongoing projects, and new business opportunities. Prepare customer visit reports, project updates, and other technical/commercial reports. Travel to different locations across Bangladesh for client meetings, site surveys, project execution, commissioning, and business development . Perform any other technical, sales, or project-related responsibilities assigned by the management. Skills & Expertise Business Development Communication Diesel Generator Sales & Marketing Sales Development Solar Energy Other Relevant Skills BOQ Client Relationship Electrical Installation and Maintenance Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Review: Yearly Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Festival Bonus: 2 Attractive salary package based on qualifications, experience, and company policy. Sales commission/bonus based on individual and business performance. Travel Allowance (TA) & Daily Allowance (DA) for official travel and project/site visits. Yearly performance-based salary increments and promotion opportunities. 3-6 months probationary period , depending on individual performance. Professional career development opportunities in Power Generation, Generator Sales, Substation, Commissioning, and Technical Sales.
