jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1541762&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Masters Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Diploma in relevant discipline from a recognized university/institute (Computer Science/Engineering, IT, Graphic Design, Marketing, or a related field with proven relevant experience). Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Trading or Export/Import Additional Requirements Age At least 23 years Experience: 1–3 years in Website Development, Graphic Design, and LinkedIn Lead Generation. (Freshers with strong portfolios are also encouraged to apply for Executive role). Graphic Design: Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva, with experience in poster, brochure, and print design. Video editing skills (Premiere Pro / CapCut) are a plus. Website Development: Hands-on experience with WordPress / Wix / Shopify, responsive design, basic HTML/CSS, and SEO fundamentals. LinkedIn Lead Generation: Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, lead research, outreach/follow-up, and CRM or lead tracking. Strong practical and interpersonal skills; must be able to submit a portfolio of design, website, and lead generation work. Ability Good written communication skills in both Bengali and English Responsibilities & Context Job Summary FVL – Fatiha Venture LTD. is a leading import and distribution company. We are looking for a creative, energetic, and tech-savvy professional to join our team as an Executive/Senior Executive (IT & Digital Marketing). In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining our website, creating engaging print and digital designs (posters, brochures and more), and generating quality business leads through LinkedIn. Key Responsibilities (Job Responsibilities) Graphic & Print Design: Design attractive posters, brochures, banners, flyers, leaflets, and other promotional materials using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva. Create social media graphics, LinkedIn post creatives, website assets, and digital advertisement designs. Ensure all designs align with the brand’s identity and visual guidelines. Prepare company brochure, company profile, catalogue, banner, poster, and leaflet for print and digital campaigns/programs, ensuring print-ready quality. Website Development & Maintenance: Design, develop, and launch responsive websites and landing pages using WordPress, Wix, Shopify, or similar platforms. Maintain and update the company website, including content, banners, product pages, plugins, and themes. Ensure website speed, mobile responsiveness, security, and basic SEO best practices. Manage domain, hosting, SSL, regular backups, and system updates. Track website performance (Google Analytics / Search Console) and implement improvements. LinkedIn Lead Generation & Outreach: Research and identify potential clients, distributors, and B2B prospects using LinkedIn (Sales Navigator) and other tools. Build targeted lead lists, send connection requests and personalized outreach messages, and follow up consistently. Manage and grow the company LinkedIn page; plan, schedule, and publish regular posts to build brand presence. Maintain a lead database/CRM, track outreach performance (response rate, qualified leads), and report to management regularly. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Adobe Photoshop Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Graphic Design Linkedin marketing Social Media Management Compensation & Other Benefits Salary: Negotiable (Based on experience & capability). Mobile allowance Festive bonus, and other benefits as per company policy. Friendly work environment and career growth opportunities. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Aftabnagar)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1541905&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Management, Marketing, or a related field. Candidates with relevant academic background and practical experience in e-commerce, procurement, inventory, or supply chain operations will be preferred. Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): E-commerce, E-commerce Startup Additional Requirements Age At least 23 years Only Female Strong vendor/supplier management and negotiation skills. Good knowledge of inventory management and purchasing processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets and willingness to work with POS/ERP systems. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines. Willingness to conduct market visits when required. Strong attention to detail, particularly in product data, pricing, and inventory management. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Experience: 1–3 years of relevant experience in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Inventory, E-commerce Operations, Vendor Management, or a related field. Freshers with strong knowledge and interest in supply chain and e-commerce operations may also be considered. Key Skills Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Vendor Management, Inventory Management, Purchasing, E-commerce Operations, Product Management, Market Research, Negotiation, POS/ERP, Data Management, Pricing & Promotion, Supplier Coordination Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities: Manage suppliers and maintain strong, professional relationships with existing and potential vendors. Review and compare multiple supplier quotations and order sheets to identify the most competitive options. Conduct market and brand research to identify high-demand, top-selling, and potential “hero” products for onboarding. Identify slow-moving and dead stock and take necessary initiatives to improve inventory turnover. Monitor near-expiry products and coordinate timely clearance or promotional activities. Maintain regular communication and coordination with suppliers regarding orders, pricing, availability, delivery, and other business matters. Schedule and coordinate meetings with suppliers and relevant internal teams. Conduct physical market visits to gather market insights, monitor competitors, and identify new product opportunities. Perform daily operational activities and maintain accurate product and inventory data in the POS system. Coordinate with the product upload team to ensure accurate and timely product listings. Maintain regular communication with the warehouse team regarding stock availability, receiving, dispatch, and inventory-related issues. Assist in inventory control, procurement, purchasing, and replenishment activities. Verify and audit product names, images, descriptions, specifications, and other product information. Monitor and manage product pricing, promotional pricing, discounts, and offers. Coordinate products and offers for various sales campaigns and promotional activities. Generate content ideas based on products, campaigns, and promotional requirements and coordinate with content creators for execution. Assist in preparing and reviewing product-related captions and promotional content. Plan and prepare themes, product selections, talking points, and scripts for live selling sessions. Prepare and monitor supplier payment schedules and coordinate with relevant teams regarding vendor payments and outstanding dues. Maintain proper records and reports related to suppliers, purchasing, inventory, pricing, and product activities. Perform other operational and ad-hoc responsibilities as assigned by the management. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only females are allowed to apply. Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Verify and audit product names, images, descriptions, specifications, and other product information.

Coordinate products and offers for various sales campaigns and promotional activities.
Generate content ideas based on products, campaigns, and promotional requirements and coordinate with content creators for execution.
Assist in preparing and reviewing product-related captions and promotional content.
Plan and prepare themes, product selections, talking points, and scripts for live selling sessions.
Prepare and monitor supplier payment schedules and coordinate with relevant teams regarding vendor payments and outstanding dues.
Maintain proper records and reports related to suppliers, purchasing, inventory, pricing, and product activities.
Perform other operational and ad-hoc responsibilities as assigned by the management.

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting, Finance
raw_source_fields.age: 28 to 35 years Responsibilities & Context The Credit Recovery Officer will be responsible for monitoring outstanding dues, contacting clients for payment collection, and maintaining proper records of receivables. The role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to handle sensitive financial matters professionally. Monitor and track all overdue payments. Contact clients via phone, email, and in person to follow up on pending dues. Negotiate and arrange suitable payment plans when necessary. Communicate with clients to obtain necessary documentation and provide updates on their credit status. Maintain accurate records of all collection activities and payment transactions. Prepare and submit regular reports on credit recovery progress to the management. Coordinate with the sales and accounts team to resolve billing disputes or discrepancies. Taking the challenge to meet the credit recovery target and report to the Management; Ensure documentation of all collection related reports, work plans, and office correspondent. Generate reports on credit recovery performance and provide insights for process improvements. Stay updated on industry regulations and best practices related to credit management and recovery. Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and periodic departmental reports. Maintain and regularly update the departmental customer database. Monitor and maintain the departmental target and achievement records. Conduct physical collection from customers as required. Perform computer-based reporting, data entry, and record maintenance efficiently. Skills & Expertise Communication and interpersonal skill Good vocal tone is desired Professionalism Reporting and Documentation Work Under Pressure Other Relevant Skills Client Relationship Credit Administration Credit Control And Recovery

Requirements Education Masters Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Advertising Agency, Electronic Equipment/Home Appliances Additional Requirements Age At least 27 years Only Male Responsibilities & Context Must be fluent in English, both speaking and writing, to effectively communicate with foreign suppliers, shipping lines, and other international stakeholders. Requirements Education Master’s Degree in Accounting/Finance from a recognised university Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO, Development Agency Additional Requirements Age At least 28 years At least 3 years of professional experience in accounting and administrative functions, preferably with a reputed national or international NGO. Sound knowledge and practical skills in accounting, procurement, inventory management, VAT/Tax compliance and financial reporting. Adequate knowledge of and practical experience with accounting software. Proficiency in common IT applications, including MS Word, MS PowerPoint, internet browsing and email communication. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues, partners and other stakeholders. Ability to prioritize tasks, work under pressure, meet deadlines and manage multiple tasks effectively. Responsibilities & Context Young Power in Social Action (YPSA) <www.ypsa.org> is an organization for sustainable development, working in the greater Chattogram division including Hill Tracts (CHT) since 1985 (International Youth Year). YPSA is going to implement a project titled “SheFarms” at Chakaria and Mathamuhuri in Cox’s Bazar. The project will be implemented with fund from the Federal German Ministry of Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and technical support from Plan International Bangladesh. Job Title: Finance and Admin Assistant Duration: 28 Months No. of Vacancy: 1 Job Description/Responsibilities: General Responsibilities Support the Finance and Admin Officer in day-to-day financial and administrative activities of the SheFarms project. Support recording and documentation of project-related financial transactions in accordance with YPSA financial policies and procedures. Ensure timely, accurate, and complete filing of financial and administrative documents. Support project field teams with finance and administrative matters related to implementation of activities. Maintain confidentiality and proper custody of financial, personnel, and administrative records. Support compliance with approved budgets, financial procedures, documentation requirements, and internal controls. Provide necessary financial and administrative information to the Finance and Admin Officer for monitoring, reporting, and decision-making. Technical Responsibilities in Finance and Financial Documentation Support day-to-day recording of SheFarms field-level transactions, including Community Mobilizer per diems and Union-level meeting expenses. Prepare, check, and file payment vouchers, bills, receipts, attendance sheets, and other supporting documents for field activities. Maintain complete financial documentation for activities implemented across the five target Unions, including demonstration plots, courtyard sessions, Farmer Field Days, trainings, and meetings. Support verification of expenditure documents against approved budgets, activity plans, and applicable financial procedures. Assist in preparing financial summaries and transaction information for project monitoring and reporting. Support reconciliation and follow-up of field-level advances and liquidations, as assigned by the Finance and Admin Officer. Ensure proper filing and retrieval of financial documents for internal review, audit, and donor compliance. Administrative and Logistics Support Support logistics arrangements for SheFarms events, including Multi-Stakeholder Coordination Committee meetings, quarterly progress reviews, trainings, workshops, and other project events. Coordinate with field staff and relevant service providers to ensure timely availability of venues, materials, refreshments, transportation, and other logistical requirements. Maintain the SheFarms asset register for project-procured equipment and materials, including demonstration plot tools and training materials. Support physical verification, tagging, custody, and documentation of project assets as required. Maintain inventory records and support proper management of project supplies and materials. Maintain attendance and leave records of the Chakaria-based SheFarms field team and submit relevant information to the Finance and Admin Officer. Support preparation and maintenance of administrative records, correspondence, and other project documents. IT Competencies Proficient in MS Excel for financial records, transaction tracking, attendance, leave, inventory, and asset records. Proficient in MS Word and PowerPoint for preparation of administrative documents and presentations. Able to use email, internet, and other common IT applications for communication and documentation. Ability to maintain electronic databases, spreadsheets, and organised digital filing systems. Ability to prepare basic financial and administrative tables, summaries, and reports using relevant IT applications. Others Maintain effective working relationships with project staff, field teams, vendors, service providers, and relevant stakeholders. Support timely communication between the project field team and Finance and Admin Officer on financial, administrative, and logistical matters. Ensure proper handling and confidentiality of financial, personnel, and project information. Support internal monitoring, audit, verification, and compliance processes as required. Assist in maintaining an organized and efficient office and field-level administrative system. Follow YPSA policies, procedures, financial controls, safeguarding requirements, and other applicable organizational standards as well as of Plan International Bangladesh, BMZ and Govt. rules. Perform any other finance and administrative duties assigned by the Finance and Admin Officer or Project Coordinator. Job Location: Chakaria and Mathamuhuri, Cox’s Bazar Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounting Accounts and Finance Coordination Financial Reporting Monitoring Reporting and Documentation Tax (VAT/ Customs Duty/ Income Tax) Compensation & Other Benefits Monthly Consolidated Salary: BDT 45,550/- Workplace Work at office Employment Status Contractual Job Location Coxs Bazar

Maintain complete financial documentation for activities implemented across the five target Unions, including demonstration plots, courtyard sessions, Farmer Field Days, trainings, and meetings. Support verification of expenditure documents against approved budgets, activity plans, and applicable financial procedures. Assist in preparing financial summaries and transaction information for project monitoring and reporting. Support reconciliation and follow-up of field-level advances and liquidations, as assigned by the Finance and Admin Officer. Ensure proper filing and retrieval of financial documents for internal review, audit, and donor compliance. Administrative and Logistics Support Support logistics arrangements for SheFarms events, including Multi-Stakeholder Coordination Committee meetings, quarterly progress reviews, trainings, workshops, and other project events. Coordinate with field staff and relevant service providers to ensure timely availability of venues, materials, refreshments, transportation, and other logistical requirements. Maintain the SheFarms asset register for project-procured equipment and materials, including demonstration plot tools and training materials. Support physical verification, tagging, custody, and documentation of project assets as required. Maintain inventory records and support proper management of project supplies and materials. Maintain attendance and leave records of the Chakaria-based SheFarms field team and submit relevant information to the Finance and Admin Officer. Support preparation and maintenance of administrative records, correspondence, and other project documents. IT Competencies Proficient in MS Excel for financial records, transaction tracking, attendance, leave, inventory, and asset records. Proficient in MS Word and PowerPoint for preparation of administrative documents and presentations. Able to use email, internet, and other common IT applications for communication and documentation. Ability to maintain electronic databases, spreadsheets, and organised digital filing systems. Ability to prepare basic financial and administrative tables, summaries, and reports using relevant IT applications. Others Maintain effective working relationships with project staff, field teams, vendors, service providers, and relevant stakeholders. Support timely communication between the project field team and Finance and Admin Officer on financial, administrative, and logistical matters. Ensure proper handling and confidentiality of financial, personnel, and project information. Support internal monitoring, audit, verification, and compliance processes as required. Assist in maintaining an organized and efficient office and field-level administrative system. Follow YPSA policies, procedures, financial controls, safeguarding requirements, and other applicable organizational standards as well as of Plan International Bangladesh, BMZ and Govt. rules. Perform any other finance and administrative duties assigned by the Finance and Admin Officer or Project Coordinator. Requirements Education Master of Commerce (MCom) in Accounting, Finance Bachelor of Commerce (BCom) in Accounting, Finance Training on financial management, planning, financial reporting, project accounting and PPR 2025. Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Development Agency Additional Requirements Age At most 45 years Experience of working in coastal regions of Bangladesh on development projects. Advanced accounting skills and practical knowledge of standard accounting software. Interpersonal skills to perform adequately in a team environment and with parter organizations. Responsibilities & Context Bangladesh is recognized as one of the country’s most vulnerable to the impacts of climate change. Climate-induced hazards have significantly affected the livelihoods, health and living conditions of coastal communities. Among the most critical challenges is the scarcity of safe drinking water, as fresh water sources are increasingly becoming saline and unusable for human consumption. To improve access to safe drinking water and strengthen the climate resilience of vulnerable coastal communities in selected areas, CODEC will implement the project titled “Access to safe Drinking Water for the Climate Vulnerable People in Coastal Areas of Bangladesh through Solar-generated Reverse Osmosis Water Treatment Facilities.” The officer will be responsible for the following duties: Operate and maintain a computerized accounting system to record all financial transactions of the sub project accurately and promptly. Prepare and submit monthly financial report and six monthly reimbursement report according to the PKSF’s Project Management Unit of Safe Water Project (SWP) financial guideline and template. Monitor the flow of funds from the Project to the sub project and ensure disbursement of funds to vendors, contractors and for operational expenses in accordance with approved budgets. Assist in the preparation of cost proposals for new activities, training and other project related events. Assist to prepare tender documents and evaluation procedure of RO plant installation and constructions according to PPR 2025. Frequent field visit to monitor the RO plant. Any other task which is assign by CODEC, PKSF and Donor. Skills & Expertise Accounting Financial Management Reporting Employment Status Full Time Job Location Bagerhat, Khulna, Satkhira
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Frequent field visit to monitor the RO plant.
Any other task which is assign by CODEC, PKSF and Donor.

Excellent oral and written communication skills in English and Bangla. Strong computer proficiency, especially in MS Office Packages (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Responsibilities & Context Bangladesh is recognized as one of the country’s most vulnerable to the impacts of climate change. The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) has identified the coastal region as one of the major climate hotspot areas due to increasing salinity intrusion, sea-level rise, cyclones, storm surges, tidal flooding, and coastal erosion. These climate-induced hazards have significantly affected the livelihoods, health, and living conditions of coastal communities. Among the most critical challenges is the scarcity of safe drinking water, as freshwater sources are increasingly becoming saline and unsuitable for human consumption. The experience of Unnayan Prochesta indicates that climate-vulnerable coastal communities continue to face severe difficulties in accessing safe and reliable drinking water. Salinity intrusion into both surface and groundwater sources, coupled with the impacts of recurrent cyclones and tidal surges, has substantially reduced the availability of potable water. As a result, people—particularly women and children—are compelled to travel long distances to collect drinking water, exposing them to health risks, economic hardship, and reduced productivity. Limited access to safe drinking water also contributes to waterborne diseases and undermines the resilience of vulnerable households. Under these circumstances, to improve access to safe drinking water and strengthen the climate resilience of vulnerable coastal communities in the selected upazilas of Khulna, Bagerhat, and Satkhira districts, Unnayan Prochesta will implement the project titled “ Access to Safe Drinking Water for the Climate Vulnerable People in Coastal Areas of Bangladesh through Solar-generated Reverse Osmosis Water Treatment Facilities.” The project will be financed by the Adaptation Fund (AF) through Palli Karma-Sahayak Foundation (PKSF) and will be implemented over a period of two years. The Officer will be responsible for the following duties: Maintain separate books of accounts for the sub-project on an accrual basis under the historical cost convention, following the accounting manual of PKSF, International Accounting Standards (IAS) and International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). Operate and maintain a computerized accounting system to record all financial transactions of the sub-project accurately and promptly. Prepare and submit monthly financial report and six-monthly reimbursement report according to the PKSF’s Project Management Unit (PMU) of Safe water Project (SWP) financial guideline and template. Support the preparation of annual, half-yearly, and quarterly budgets for the sub-project, aligning with procurement plans and work plans. Monitor the flow of funds from the Project to the sub-project and ensure smooth disbursement of funds to vendors, contractors, and for operational expenses in accordance with approved budgets. Prepare and submit annual financial statements incorporating disclosure on income and expenditure, receipts and payments, and the financial position of the sub-project, along with relevant notes and information. Ensure adequate internal controls are in place for the proper utilization, management, and accounting of funds at the sub-project level. Prepare monthly bank reconciliation statements for sub-project bank accounts. Prepare and review all sub-project budgets, reimbursement bills, and financial claims from partners/vendors before submission to the PMU. Assist in the preparation of cost proposals for new activities, training, and other project-related events. Ensure that shared cost amounts are correctly budgeted in each proposal for sub-project activities. Coordinate with PKSF’s PMU of SWP accounts and internal audit department of PO’s by providing necessary information and documentation for audits. Support external auditors with required information, records, and documentation for project/sub-project audits. Review external and internal audit reports, along with management letters, and assist in implementing audit recommendations. Provide advice and monitoring support to project and PO’s staff on the efficient operation of sub-project bank accounts and fund utilization. Ensure compliance with all PKSF’s PMU of SWP financial, accounting and procurement policies, procedures and donor requirements. Work in coordination with the PKSF’s Project Management Unit (PMU) of Safe Water Project (SWP) for financial validation, reporting, and quality assurance. Assist to prepare tender documents and evaluation procedure of RO plant installation and construction according to PPR 2025. Frequent field visit to monitor the RO Plant. Any other task which is assign by (name of the partner organization), PKSF and Donor. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542507&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education HSC Bachelor of Commerce (Pass) Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Bachelor of Arts (BA) Additional Requirements Age 22 to 30 years Only Male Experience: 1–3 years of experience in field sales / territory sales / order collection preferred. Candidates with relevant sales experience in Electrical, Electronics, Lighting, Switch-Socket, Home Appliance will be preferred. Freshers with strong communication skills and willingness to work in the field may also apply. Additional Requirements: Good communication and interpersonal skills. Strong relationship-building ability with retailers and channel partners. Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory. Ability to work independently and achieve sales targets. Must be energetic, hardworking and target-oriented. Basic knowledge of MS Office / mobile-based reporting will be an advantage. Candidates with experience in the electrical products market will get preference. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for energetic, target-oriented and market-focused Field Officers to strengthen our sales team and expand our distribution network across Bangladesh. The selected candidates will be responsible for regular market visits, retailer coverage, order collection, sales achievement and channel development in their assigned territory. Job Location : Anywhere in Bangladesh / Mohammadpur, Mirpur, Badda, Gulshan, Uttara, Old Dhaka, Narayangonj, Mymensingh, Jamalpur, Tangail, Bogra, Gaibandha, Rangpur, Dinajpur, Thakurgaon, Panchagarh, Savar, Manikganj Job Responsibilities Regularly visit assigned markets, retailers, dealers and distributors. Generate sales orders from retailers and channel partners. Develop and maintain strong relationships with retailers, dealers and distributors. Ensure regular product availability and market coverage in the assigned territory. Achieve monthly sales and collection targets. Introduce and promote company products to retailers and customers. Monitor competitors’ products, prices, promotions and market activities. Collect market feedback regarding product demand, pricing, quality and customer requirements. Follow up on orders, deliveries, payments and customer complaints. Support distributors/dealers in developing their respective markets. Prepare daily market visit reports and submit regular sales updates to the supervisor. Ensure proper execution of company sales policies, promotional activities and market programs. Skills & Expertise Sales Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment. Safeguard company assets by controlling inventory age, maintaining furniture and fixtures, handling customer claims, and ensuring proper receiving, dispatch, and transfer of merchandise. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542501&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education BBA/MBA/M.Com in Accounting, Finance or related discipline. Fresh graduates or candidates with 1 year of relevant experience may apply. Experience Additional Requirements Age At least 25 years Basic understanding of accounting, inventory control and audit procedures. Good numerical and analytical skills with strong attention to detail. Working knowledge of MS Excel. ERP/Oracle experience will be an added advantage. Candidates should be honest, responsible and willing to perform regular physical inventory checks. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for energetic, detail-oriented professionals to join our Finance Team in the role of Executive – Finance Audit & Controls . Conduct regular physical inventory counts and stock verification across stores, warehouses and production-related inventory locations. Reconcile physical inventory with ERP/system records and investigate shortages, excesses and variances. Perform surprise stock counts and other inventory control checks. Review inventory movement, consumption, adjustments, transfers, wastage and supporting documentation. Review vouchers, bills, invoices, payments and other financial transactions for accuracy and compliance. Verify proper approvals and supporting documents. Check procurement and other finance-related transactions. Identify discrepancies, unusual transactions and internal control gaps. Prepare clear checking/audit observations and follow up on corrective actions. Support periodic internal control reviews and physical verification of assets where required. Ensure compliance with company policies and financial control procedures. Skills & Expertise Accounts and audit Accounts and Finance Data analysis Microsoft Office Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Cumilla (Cumilla Adarsha Sadar)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542338&fc.title: Executive - Internal Audit

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Candidates must have completed CA (CC) from a renowned CA firm.
raw_source_fields.age: At least 25 years Only Male Responsibilities & Context Perform post-audit verification to ensure proper implementation of audit observations and corrective actions. Verify inventory, stock records, and project materials against physical quantities and supporting documents. Monitor advances, outstanding balances, collections, and related documentation. Review and verify project expenses, and supporting documents for accuracy and compliance. Verify vehicle-related documents, including logbooks, fuel records, maintenance records, bills, and other supporting documents. Identify discrepancies, control weaknesses, irregularities, and potential financial or operational risks and report them to management. Check compliance with company policies, procedures, and internal control requirements. Prepare audit findings, verification reports, and other audit-related reports with clear observations and recommendations. Coordinate with relevant departments and project teams to obtain necessary documents, explanations, and supporting information. Follow up on previous audit findings and monitor the status of corrective actions. Maintain proper audit working papers, records, checklists, and supporting documents for future reference. Conduct field visits to project locations and business concerns when required for audit and verification purposes.
raw_source_fields.gender: Only males are allowed to apply.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542679&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Bachelors/Masters degree / BBA / MBA (Preferred: in Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Finance or a related discipline). Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (Light Engineering and Heavy Industry), Paper Additional Requirements Age At most 40 years Experience: 2 to 3 years of core experience in commercial and supply chain operations (manufacturing/ paper industry experience preferred). Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of UCP 600, Incoterms, customs clearance procedures, and import-export regulations in Bangladesh. Skills: Excellent negotiation, vendor management, analytical and reporting skills. Responsibilities & Context Key Responsibilities: Procurement Management: Handle foreign and local procurement, process purchase orders, and develop strategic procurement plans. Commercial & LC Operations: Manage Letters of Credit (LC) end-to-end under UCP 600, review import/export shipment documentation, and track shipments. Customs & C&F Coordination: Oversee C&F agents and customs clearing processes to ensure timely release of cargo. Regulatory Liaison: Maintain effective liaison with government and regulatory bodies (BIDA, CCIE, BAERA, Customs Houses, etc.). Vendor & Supply Chain Strategy: Build supplier databases, manage vendor selection and relations, and implement efficient supply chain strategies. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Purchase/ Procurement Purchase and Procurement Supply Chain Management Export/ Import through L/C Freight Forwarding/ C&F Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Accounting CA (Chartered Accountancy) qualification or relevant CA-level qualification, as required by the employer. A Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline may be preferred. Professional accounting qualifications and relevant training will be considered an advantage. Responsibilities & Context Mainamoti Medical College & Hospital is seeking a qualified, responsible, and detail-oriented Accounts Officer to manage financial records, accounting operations, and financial reporting. The selected candidate will support the organization's financial management, ensure accurate documentation, and maintain compliance with applicable accounting standards and financial regulations Maintain daily financial transactions, accounting records, and ledgers. Prepare financial statements, reports, and management accounts. Monitor income, expenditure, cash flow, and budget utilization. Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations. Assist in preparing annual budgets and financial forecasts. Ensure accurate preparation of vouchers, bills, invoices, and payment documents. Support internal and external audits and coordinate with auditors. Ensure compliance with applicable tax, VAT, and other financial regulations. Monitor financial documentation and maintain proper filing systems. Prepare periodic financial reports for management review. Perform other accounting and finance-related duties assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Cash Flow Management Budget Management Bank Reconciliation Budgeting and Forecasting VAT Compliance Compensation & Other Benefits As per Policy Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Cumilla

Responsibilities & Context Department: Diving Operations About the Position Nishi Salvage & Diving is looking for a responsible, confident and firm Field Coordinator to manage and coordinate our commercial diving teams during underwater inspection and marine diving projects. This position is primarily a field coordination and people-management role . The successful candidate will work closely with divers, diving supervisors, boat crews and office management to ensure that diving operations are properly coordinated, disciplined and completed according to the project requirements. The person will also be responsible for preparing underwater inspection reports, organizing inspection documentation and editing underwater photographs and videos . We are looking for someone who can manage people firmly but professionally, handle disagreements calmly, maintain discipline and keep the field operation running smoothly. Key Responsibilities Field & Diving Team Coordination — Primary Responsibility Coordinate daily activities of divers, diving supervisors, boat crews and field personnel. Ensure that the diving team understands the assigned scope of work and daily requirements. Coordinate manpower, diving equipment, boats and other field requirements with the operations team. Monitor the attendance, discipline and work performance of field personnel. Ensure that instructions from management and the Diving Supervisor are properly communicated and followed. Maintain a professional and respectful working environment among divers and field workers. Handle disagreements, misunderstandings and conflicts between team members before they affect the diving operation. Act as a communication bridge between the office, diving team, vessel crew, clients and supervisors. Keep management updated about field progress, manpower issues, operational problems and delays. Take immediate action on routine field coordination issues and escalate serious matters to management. Ensure that unnecessary arguments, disputes or personal issues do not disrupt the project. Maintain discipline while treating field workers fairly and professionally. Coordinate mobilization and demobilization of diving teams and equipment. Travel to vessels, ports, terminals, shipyards and other project locations as required. Be available outside normal office hours when required by vessel schedules or diving operations. Project Monitoring & Field Reporting Monitor daily progress of underwater inspection and diving activities. Collect accurate information from divers and diving supervisors. Maintain daily field activity records. Record completed work, pending work, difficulties and important observations. Communicate field updates to management on time. Coordinate with vessel representatives, clients and surveyors when required. Ensure that required photographs, videos and inspection information are collected during the operation. Underwater Inspection Documentation Prepare professional underwater inspection reports based on information collected from the diving team. Organize inspection findings, photographs, videos and observations. Prepare daily work reports, inspection records, checklists and other project documentation. Review diver notes and underwater inspection findings for completeness. Compile technical information into clear and properly formatted reports. Maintain proper records for completed diving projects. Ensure reports are prepared and submitted within project deadlines. Underwater Photo & Video Editing Review underwater inspection photographs and videos recorded during diving operations. Select relevant photographs and video footage for reports. Edit underwater inspection videos for client and surveyor presentation. Add vessel name, inspection area, date, location, labels and other relevant information where required. Organize and properly store project photos, videos and final reports. Maintain an organized digital archive of completed projects. Skills & Expertise People Management skill Report Writing Video Editing Other Relevant Skills Documentation Team management Video Editing Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. raw_source_fields.education: Additional Requirements
raw_source_fields.age: At least 18 years Responsibilities & Context Job Summary The selected candidates will work on researching real estate market trends, analyzing customer preferences, evaluating competitors and identifying new opportunities for property development. This role is ideal for fresh marketing graduates who are eager to apply their academic knowledge to real-world business challenges and contribute innovative ideas to the company's growth. Key Responsibilities Conduct market surveys and research to understand real estate market trends, customer preferences and emerging opportunities. Collect and analyze information on property prices, apartment sizes, project features, customer demand and competitor activities. Visit real estate projects, residential and commercial areas to gather firsthand market intelligence. Conduct customer surveys and interviews with prospective buyers, property owners, brokers and other relevant stakeholders. Analyse competitors' projects, pricing strategies, amenities, promotional activities and market positioning. Identify potential locations, customer segments and emerging trends for new residential and commercial development projects. Generate innovative ideas for new property development concepts, product offerings and market positioning. Prepare market research reports, presentations and recommendations for management. Maintain databases of market information, competitor projects and customer feedback. Collaborate with management and other departments to support strategic planning and business development initiatives.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542966&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Management, or a related field. MBA/PGD in HRM will be an advantage. Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Retail Store Additional Requirements Only Male Must be proactive, energetic, responsible, and well-organized. Willingness to visit factory/production facilities regularly as required. Willingness to handle HR, administration, procurement, and factory coordination responsibilities. Must have good interpersonal and communication skills. Candidates who can join immediately or within a short notice period will get preference. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Experience Requirements 1–3 years of relevant experience in HR & Administration. Candidates with experience in HR operations, recruitment, attendance management, employee documentation, payroll support, administrative procurement, factory coordination, and general administration will be preferred. Experience in manufacturing, FMCG, retail, or factory-based organizations will be an advantage. Required Skills & Competencies Good knowledge of HR & Administrative functions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good command of MS Office, particularly MS Excel and MS Word. Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation. Good organizational and time-management skills. Strong coordination and negotiation skills. Basic understanding of procurement and vendor management. Ability to handle confidential information professionally. Strong problem-solving and multitasking abilities. Strong sense of responsibility, discipline, and professionalism. Ability to work independently as well as in a team. Ability to communicate effectively with factory workers, employees, management, vendors, and external parties. Responsibilities & Context Department: Human Resources & Administration Job Summary: We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and well-organized HR & Admin Executive to manage day-to-day HR, administrative, procurement, and factory coordination activities. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, strong interpersonal ability, practical knowledge of HR operations, and the ability to handle multiple administrative responsibilities efficiently. Key Responsibilities HR Responsibilities Assist in end-to-end recruitment activities, including job posting, CV screening, interview scheduling, candidate coordination, and onboarding. Maintain and update employee personal files, HR records, attendance, leave, and other employee-related documents. Prepare and maintain appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, transfer letters, warning letters, and other HR documents. Monitor daily attendance, late attendance, leave, overtime, and employee movement. Assist in monthly payroll preparation and provide necessary HR-related data. Ensure proper implementation of company HR policies, rules, procedures, and guidelines. Handle employee queries and provide necessary support regarding HR-related matters. raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Administration with a concentration in Marketing, Management, Operations, or a related discipline from a reputed institution.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1543060&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Administration with a concentration in Marketing, Management, Operations, or a related discipline from a reputed institution. Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Additional Job Requirements: Undertake frequent field travel to support destination operations, with increased or back-to-back travel during peak seasons, major B2B operations and festivals. Provide on-ground operational support during major B2B operations, festivals and peak periods to ensure effective coordination, timely issue resolution and smooth execution of field activities. Experience Requirements: Minimum 3 years of relevant experience, preferably in field operations, event management, large-scale project or programme coordination, customer experience management, or related functions. Responsibilities & Context BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh that partners with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty globally to create sustainable opportunities to realise potential. Working at BRAC is not like any other job. It is a platform where you can bring about real change for people who need it the most. We are not just dreaming of a better world; we are building it. Join us to find the way. BRAC Otithi is committed to transforming tourism in Bangladesh by connecting urban travelers with rural communities, showcasing the country's hidden cultural and natural heritage, and promoting sustainable tourism that creates lasting social and economic impact. Drive high-quality field operations through effective team coordination and stakeholder engagement. We are looking for a dynamic professional for the role of Deputy Manager, Research & Field Operations to ensure consistent and high-quality execution across destinations, B2B trips, festivals, day trips and other tourism experiences, while strengthening guest experience, community engagement and operational efficiency. The role will also contribute to research, destination development and product improvement. Key Responsibilities: Field Operations & Service Quality: Manage field operations across Otithi destinations by planning and coordinating B2B trips, festivals, day trips, and other experiences while ensuring appropriate resources, schedules, and operational readiness. Ensure smooth and consistent trip execution by coordinating with Area Managers, Assistant Area Managers, guides, community partners, vendors, and other field stakeholders and resolving operational issues on time. Monitor guest experience and operational quality by tracking customer feedback, service standards, field performance, and operational risks and implementing appropriate improvements. Team & Community Engagement: Strengthen field capacity and operational readiness by supporting the onboarding, training, and development of Area Managers, Assistant Area Managers, guides, and other relevant field resources. Manage community and destination-level partnerships by maintaining relationships with local stakeholders and coordinating community welfare, development, and impact initiatives across Otithi destinations. Operational & Financial Management: Coordinate operational and financial planning for trips and destinations by supporting costing and COGS planning, monitoring field-level expenses and settlements, and analysing cost variances to improve efficiency and product margins. Product Development & Innovation: Customise and improve Otithi products and itineraries by incorporating client requirements, destination capacity, operational feasibility, guest feedback, and field learning into pricing and experience design. Support new destination and product development by conducting field assessments, destination research, and community consultations and contributing to feasibility assessments, itinerary development, pricing, and pilot experiences. Drive continuous operational and product innovation by identifying and testing new experience formats, analysing market and guest insights, and applying operational and community learning to existing and new offerings. Responsible & Ethical Tourism: Ensure responsible and ethical tourism practices by integrating safeguarding, cultural sensitivity, informed participation, privacy, community dignity, responsible use of cultural knowledge, and environmental responsibility into field operations. Safeguarding Responsibilities: Ensure the safety of Programme Participants, people who come into contact with the organisation, and team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment, and exploitation, including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) to achieve the programme goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance, and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment. Practice, promote, and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members, and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so. Compensation & Other Benefits Festival Bonus, Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, Health and Life Insurance, Maternity/ Paternity Leave, Wellness Centre Facility, Day Care Facility, and others as per policy. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

BRAC Otithi is committed to transforming tourism in Bangladesh by connecting urban travelers with rural communities, showcasing the country's hidden cultural and natural heritage, and promoting sustainable tourism that creates lasting social and economic impact. Drive high-quality field operations through effective team coordination and stakeholder engagement. We are looking for a dynamic professional for the role of Deputy Manager, Research & Field Operations to ensure consistent and high-quality execution across destinations, B2B trips, festivals, day trips and other tourism experiences, while strengthening guest experience, community engagement and operational efficiency. The role will also contribute to research, destination development and product improvement. Key Responsibilities: Field Operations & Service Quality: Manage field operations across Otithi destinations by planning and coordinating B2B trips, festivals, day trips, and other experiences while ensuring appropriate resources, schedules, and operational readiness. Ensure smooth and consistent trip execution by coordinating with Area Managers, Assistant Area Managers, guides, community partners, vendors, and other field stakeholders and resolving operational issues on time. Monitor guest experience and operational quality by tracking customer feedback, service standards, field performance, and operational risks and implementing appropriate improvements. Team & Community Engagement: Strengthen field capacity and operational readiness by supporting the onboarding, training, and development of Area Managers, Assistant Area Managers, guides, and other relevant field resources. Manage community and destination-level partnerships by maintaining relationships with local stakeholders and coordinating community welfare, development, and impact initiatives across Otithi destinations. Operational & Financial Management: Coordinate operational and financial planning for trips and destinations by supporting costing and COGS planning, monitoring field-level expenses and settlements, and analysing cost variances to improve efficiency and product margins. Product Development & Innovation: Customise and improve Otithi products and itineraries by incorporating client requirements, destination capacity, operational feasibility, guest feedback, and field learning into pricing and experience design. Support new destination and product development by conducting field assessments, destination research, and community consultations and contributing to feasibility assessments, itinerary development, pricing, and pilot experiences. Drive continuous operational and product innovation by identifying and testing new experience formats, analysing market and guest insights, and applying operational and community learning to existing and new offerings. Responsible & Ethical Tourism: Ensure responsible and ethical tourism practices by integrating safeguarding, cultural sensitivity, informed participation, privacy, community dignity, responsible use of cultural knowledge, and environmental responsibility into field operations. Safeguarding Responsibilities: Ensure the safety of Programme Participants, people who come into contact with the organisation, and team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment, and exploitation, including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) to achieve the programme goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance, and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment. Practice, promote, and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members, and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so. Compensation & Other Benefits Festival Bonus, Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, Health and Life Insurance, Maternity/ Paternity Leave, Wellness Centre Facility, Day Care Facility, and others as per policy. Comfortable handling Facebook/Messenger inboxes, WhatsApp and web-based CRM tools. Basic computer skills (MS Excel / Google Sheets) for maintaining lead and sales records. Able to multitask in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. Organized, punctual and customer-oriented. Responsibilities & Context About the Company: Torayvino BD (Mapal International) is the exclusive importer and official distributor of Japans trusted Torayvino Water Purifiers in Bangladesh. Our mission is to bring safe, affordable and high-quality water purification to every home. With a strong online presence and an expanding dealer network, we are growing fast and looking for talented people to grow with us. Job Summary: We are looking for a dynamic Sales & Customer Support Executive to handle inbound inquiries, convert leads into sales, and give customers an excellent experience after the sale. Key Responsibilities: Respond to customer inquiries on Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, website chat and phone calls. Explain product features and benefits clearly, including filtration and water quality (TDS), and guide customers to purchase. Follow up with interested leads regularly and convert them into confirmed sales. Confirm orders, enter them into the system, and coordinate with the delivery team for on-time delivery. Maintain organized records of customer conversations, leads and sales. Prepare daily/weekly sales and lead follow-up reports. Work closely with the digital marketing, retail and dealer sales teams. Handle after-sales queries and keep customers satisfied. Job Location Dhaka (DOHS Banani)

PGD in HRM will be an added advantage Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): University Additional Requirements A minimum of two (02) years of relevant work experience is preferred Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to derive insights from recruitment data Excellent conceptual thinking and process improvement skills to support talent acquisition and workforce planning Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and reporting tools for recruitment analytics and dashboards Ability to analyze hiring trends, recruitment metrics and workforce data to support decision-making Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage large volumes of confidential employee and candidate data Excellent organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities Methodical work approach with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail Strong cultural awareness and sensitivity Responsibilities & Context BRAC University (BRACU) follows a liberal arts approach to education which nurtures fresh ideas and gives new impetus to the field of tertiary education. raw_source_fields.education: Masters in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent subject.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542126&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Masters in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent subject. Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Age At most 45 years Able to work under pressure and willing to travel frequently to the project field. Female Candidates are encouraged to apply and given preference. Persons with disabilities and Ethnic Minority applicants are encouraged to apply. Experience in Accounts keeping and Administration, Skilled in financial analysis. Must be proficient in computer operation, particularly in MS-Excel, MS-Access, MS-Word, and MS-PowerPoint . Experience in using accounting software is preferable. At least two (2) years of experience to drive Motorcycle and having a valid motorcycle driving license. Experience: 3 years in financial and administrative roles. The applicants should have experience in a National NGO. Good Bangla communication skills and basic working knowledge of English. Willingness to travel regularly within the project area. Responsibilities & Context Job Context: Breaking the Silence is a non-profit, voluntary organization registered with the Department of Social Services (Registration No. 05037, Date: 17 September 2000) and NGOAB (Registration No. 1642, Date: 20 May 2001). The organization works to establish child rights, prevent child abuse and child sexual abuse, prevent child marriage, accelerate child-friendly good governance, improve the quality of education at the primary and pre-primary level, prevent violence against women, empowering children and women. The organization is going to implement a project named ‘Strengthening Community-Based Child Protection Systems in Industrial Communities (SCCPS) at Bhaterchar and Baluakandi in Munshigonj District Bangladesh .The project will be implemented by the support of ‘Tdh Netherland’ and funded by LC Support Foundation. The project focuses on strengthening community-based child protection systems, improving awareness, establishing community structures, and enhancing referral and coordination mechanisms to prevent and respond to child labour and other child protection issues. BTS is going to recruit a ‘Project Accontant’ for the mentioned project and the position’s desk office at Munshigonj District. Project Name: Strengthening Community-Based Child Protection Systems in Industrial Communities (SCCPS) at Bhaterchar and Baluakandi in Munshigonj District Bangladesh . Tenure of Services Contract: 3 (Three) Months probation period. After successful completion of the probation period, based on the performance of the staff and recommendation from the supervisor, the post may be continued till the project’s lifetime. Job Location: Munshigonj District Working Area: Bhaterchar and Baluakandi in Munshigonj District Job Purpose: The Project Accountant is responsible for developing and managing budgets following donor and organizational policies. Maintain accurate financial records and prepare reports for donors and management. Monitor cash flow, process payments, and manage financial transactions. Ensure compliance with financial policies and support audits. Process payroll and manage expenses with proper documentation. Train project staff on financial procedures and support procurement decisions. Keep organized financial records and ensure data confidentiality. Job Description / Responsibilities: Books of Accounts & Reporting: a) Check and ensure all bill voucher and finance documentations are made available on demand, b) Maintain up-to-date books of accounts, data entry and preserve all kinds subsidiary registers, c) Ensure all receipts and follow up of settlements of advances and evidences, d) Ensure all payments are charged into approved budget line, e) Ensure fund request, financial report and relevant documents are prepared in time, f) Maintain all kinds of banking transactions and associated tasks including bank reconciliation, g) Handling petty cash, filing of all vouchers. Prepare Periodic Report and Budget Follow-up: a) Prepare periodic (Monthly/Quarterly) budget variance analysis reports, b) Prepare and revise annual budget as per need, c) Ensure the expenditures are incurred and booked in the respective budget line, follow up and report to the Project Manager, d) Review the budget variance (under/Overspent) in the Budget line item. Administrative: a) Introduce/execute/support organization’s administrative rules & procedures, b) Preserve and update personnel files and related documents, c) Ensure logistics and materials as per program/admin requirements, d) Ensure mechanisms and direct support to staff for workable office environments, e) Review the expenditure of project office operation. Program support and Documentation: a) Conduct field visit to examine the financial documents verification, provide feedback and support to financial dealings at major events, b) Ensure delivery of classified financial data to program and Line Manger, c) Follow up day to day expenses/financial operation and advice to improving the lack and internal control system, d) Preserve and maintain filing of all important financial documents, legal documents, staff financial contract, MOU, third party contract, financial information served to GO body, donor agreements, approved plan & budget, project proposal, bank information and audit reports, e) Maintain liaison with head office administration, finance and human resource departments. Compliance: a) Ensure scrutiny of budget request/bills/payment requests and availability of budget, b) Ensure that all policies and procedures comply with donor and funding source policies, procedures, agreement clauses, along with organization’s financial policies, c) Contribute opinion in improving internal control systems, financial discipline, transparency and accountability, d) Maintain current knowledge of government requirements and ensure compliance with tax regulations and other legal regulations, e) Review financial monitoring report and follow up the compliance. Fixed Asset Management: Ensure inventory and identification of fixed assets at office and expatriate location, maintaining liaison with the relevant department of head office, b) Reviews periodically inventory/stock management. Assistance to Internal Financial Monitoring Team and Auditors: a) Ensure all financial documentation is made available on demand of the organizational financial monitoring team and external auditors, b) Response to audit queries and observation in consultation with the Finance head of the organization, c) Support to the organization in executing and follow up audit recommendations. Requirement of Donor: a) Prepare the financial reports/statements, maintaining the reporting schedule and provide other need-based financial statements as per the requirements of the donor through consultation with the organization’s Finance Head, b) Ensure the reimbursements are adjusted with proper accounts, c) Coordinate with the donor officials relating to financial matters Facilitate Tax & VAT deduction process: a) Ensure timely and proper deduction of vendor TAX, VAT, and personal TAX, and deposit of taxes timely and preserve all relevant documents, b) Information update on TAX and VAT deduction process. Others: a) Attend different project meetings and finance-related meetings of the donor, b) Attend capacity building training, orientation, and events, c) Specific tasks assigned by the organization’s Head of Finance, d) Coordinate and cooperate with project staff and finance department for smooth project financial operation, e) Any other assignments of the organization management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounting Software Financial Analysis Fixed Asset Management Microsoft Excel Microsoft PowerPoint MS Access Writing skill Compensation & Other Benefits Salary and other benefits: Gross: Taka 48,556.00 (Tk. Forty Eight Thousand FiveHundred Fifty Six ) Per Month 2 days weekend Bonus (One month equivalent salary) After job confirmation 5% salary deduction from Basic salary for depositing BTS Staff welfare fund. Office time, Annual Leave, Increment & other facilities will be applicable as per Recruitment and Human Resource Management Policy of Breaking the Silence. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Munshiganj

Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Follow up with selected candidates until their joining. Maintain a proper candidate database and recruitment tracker. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential candidates. Meet assigned monthly recruitment targets. Submit regular recruitment updates to management. The primary responsibility will be: Candidate Sourcing → CV Screening → Calling → Interview → Selection → Joining Recruitment Target The candidate will be responsible for achieving assigned monthly hiring targets and maintaining a continuous pipeline of suitable candidates.
